records.literal_gloss: Having looked up now he saw the ones casting into the treasury the gifts of them, rich [people].

en.L: And looking up, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw the rich putting their gifts into the treasury.
en.B: Jesus looked up and watched as rich people dropped their gifts into the temple's offering chests.
en.R: Jesus looked up. He saw rich people putting their gifts of money into the offering boxes in the temple.

es.L: Y alzando la mirada, vio a los que echaban sus ofrendas en el tesoro, [a los] ricos.
es.B: Jesús alzó la vista y vio a los ricos que depositaban sus ofrendas en las cajas de las ofrendas del templo.
es.R: Jesús levantó la vista. Vio a gente rica que echaba dinero como regalo en las cajas de las ofrendas del templo.

fr.L: Et, ayant levé les yeux, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vit ceux qui mettaient leurs dons dans le trésor : des riches.
fr.B: Jésus leva les yeux et regarda des riches déposer leurs dons dans les coffres des offrandes du temple.
fr.R: Jésus a levé les yeux. Il a vu des riches qui mettaient leurs dons en argent dans les coffres des offrandes du temple.

sw.L: Na alipoinua macho, aliwaona matajiri wakitia matoleo yao katika hazina.
sw.B: Yesu aliinua macho, akawaona matajiri wakitumbukiza matoleo yao katika masanduku ya sadaka ya hekalu.
sw.R: Yesu alitazama juu. Aliwaona matajiri wakitoa zawadi za fedha, wakizitia katika masanduku ya sadaka hekaluni.

vi.L: Và ngước mắt lên, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy những người giàu bỏ lễ vật của họ vào kho tiền dâng.
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu ngước lên và nhìn những người giàu đang bỏ lễ vật của họ vào các thùng dâng hiến trong đền thờ.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu ngước mắt lên. Ngài thấy những người giàu đang bỏ tiền dâng vào các thùng dâng hiến trong đền thờ.

decisions.choice: the treasury: the place in the temple courts where gifts for the temple were received, with chests to put them in
alternatives: a locked storeroom for the temple's money
decisions.reason: Jesus was teaching in the temple (20:1; 21:37). The treasury was in a court open to the people, where Jesus also taught (John 8:20), and gifts were dropped into chests there in full view (Mark 12:41).

decisions.choice: rich: the word stands last for emphasis: the givers Jesus watched were rich
alternatives: the rich as the only givers
decisions.reason: Luke holds the word back to the end of the sentence. It sets up the contrast with the poor widow in 21:2.

decisions.choice: the temple's offering chests (B); the offering boxes in the temple (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the treasury was, as the meaning decision explains, and name Jesus for clarity.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans only on separate pronouns and possessives (él, le, mi, mí, me), not on verb endings (vio, dijo)
alternatives: a span on every pronoun the English marks
decisions.reason: Spanish usually leaves the subject pronoun out and joins some object pronouns to the verb ("oírlo"), where there is nothing separate to capitalise, so the setting covers fewer words than in English, as in Mark 13. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: el tesoro (L); las cajas de las ofrendas (B, R)
decisions.reason: The treasury is the place in the temple courts with chests for gifts (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps the word's sense; Balanced and Readable say what the chests were, as the English does and as in Mark 12:41.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); Luke's imperfects kept as imperfects
decisions.reason: As in Luke 2 and 4: the passé simple is the tense of written narrative for a careful reading, and Readable tells the story in the passé composé, as French is spoken. Jesus' speeches keep the tenses of speech at every level. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: le trésor (L); les coffres des offrandes du temple (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:41: "trésor" today suggests hoarded riches, and "tronc" a church collection box; Balanced and Readable say what the treasury was (m1). Literal ends on "des riches" to keep the emphasis of the Greek word order (m2).

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span on verb prefixes (aliwaona, akasema); spans only on free pronouns and possessives (langu, yangu, zangu, kwake, mimi)
decisions.reason: Swahili carries "he" and "him" in prefixes inside the verb, which cannot take a capital, so the setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives, as in Mark 13. Swahili therefore has fewer spans than English through the chapter.

decisions.choice: hazina (L); masanduku ya sadaka (B, R)
decisions.reason: The treasury is the place in the temple courts with chests for gifts (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps the word's sense; Balanced and Readable say what the chests were, as the English does and as in Mark 12:41.

decisions.choice: "kho tiền dâng" (L); "các thùng dâng hiến trong đền thờ" (B, R) for the treasury
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:41; Balanced and Readable add where the chests were, as the English does.

decisions.choice: The narrator calls Jesus "Ngài"; Jesus says "Ta" of himself and "các con" to those listening (21:3-36); the verb for his speaking is "nói" (whole chapter)
decisions.reason: The settled forms of the style guide. In 21:5-36 Jesus teaches those who follow him, as in the parallel Mark 13, where they are "các con".

source.text: εἶδεν δέ τινα χήραν πενιχρὰν βάλλουσαν ἐκεῖ λεπτὰ δύο, καὶ εἶπεν· Ἀληθῶς λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἡ χήρα ἡ πτωχὴ αὕτη πλεῖον πάντων ἔβαλεν·

records.literal_gloss: He saw then a certain widow needy casting there lepta two, \v 3 and he said, Truly I say to you that the widow, the poor this, more than all has cast in;

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw a certain needy widow putting two lepta there, \v 3 and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "Truly I tell you, this poor widow has put in more than all [of them].
en.B: He also noticed a needy widow drop in {{units:two pennies|two lepta}}. \v 3 Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "Truly I tell you, this poor widow has given more than all the rest.
en.R: He also saw a very poor widow put in {{units:two cents|two lepta}}. \v 3 Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "I tell you the truth, this poor widow has given more than all those rich people.

es.L: Y vio a una viuda necesitada que echaba allí dos leptones, \v 3 y dijo: «En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que esta viuda pobre ha echado más que todos [ellos].
es.B: También vio a una viuda necesitada que echaba {{units:dos moneditas de cobre|dos leptones}}. \v 3 Entonces dijo: «En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que esta viuda pobre ha dado más que todos los demás.
es.R: También vio a una viuda muy pobre que echaba {{units:dos monedas de muy poco valor|dos leptones}}. \v 3 Entonces dijo: «{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: esta viuda pobre ha dado más que todos esos ricos.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vit une certaine veuve indigente qui mettait là deux leptes, \v 3 et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « En vérité, je vous le dis : cette veuve pauvre a mis plus que tous.
fr.B: Il remarqua aussi une veuve dans le besoin qui y déposait {{units:deux centimes|deux leptes}}. \v 3 Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « En vérité, je vous le dis : cette veuve pauvre a donné plus que tous les autres.
fr.R: Il a vu aussi une veuve très pauvre qui mettait {{units:deux pièces d’un centime|deux leptes}}. \v 3 Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit : « Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité : cette veuve pauvre a donné plus que tous ces riches.

sw.L: Naye akamwona mjane mmoja mhitaji akitia pale lepta mbili, \v 3 akasema, "Kweli nawaambia kwamba mjane huyu maskini ametia zaidi kuliko wote.
sw.B: Akamwona pia mjane mmoja mhitaji akitumbukiza {{units:sarafu mbili ndogo za shaba|lepta mbili}}. \v 3 Kisha akasema, "Kweli nawaambia, mjane huyu maskini ametoa zaidi kuliko wengine wote.
sw.R: Aliona pia mjane mmoja maskini sana akitia {{units:sarafu mbili zenye thamani ndogo kabisa|lepta mbili}}. \v 3 Kisha akasema, "Nawaambia ukweli: mjane huyu maskini ametoa zaidi kuliko matajiri wale wote.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy một bà góa nghèo khó kia bỏ vào đó hai đồng lép-ta, \v 3 và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con rằng bà góa nghèo này đã bỏ vào nhiều hơn tất cả [mọi người].
vi.B: Ngài cũng thấy một bà góa nghèo khó bỏ vào {{units:hai đồng xu nhỏ, chỉ đáng vài phút tiền công|hai đồng lép-ta}}. \v 3 Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, bà góa nghèo này đã dâng nhiều hơn tất cả những người khác.
vi.R: Ngài cũng thấy một bà góa rất nghèo bỏ vào {{units:hai đồng xu bé tí, gần như chẳng đáng giá gì|hai đồng lép-ta}}. \v 3 Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Ta nói thật với các con: Bà góa nghèo này đã dâng nhiều hơn tất cả những người giàu kia.

decisions.choice: lepta: the smallest coins in use
decisions.reason: A lepton was a tiny copper coin, a hundred and twenty-eighth of a denarius, the day's wage of a laborer (12:59; Mark 12:42). Two of them were almost nothing.

decisions.choice: needy; poor: two words for being poor, the second the stronger
decisions.reason: The narrator calls her needy, someone who has very little. Jesus calls her poor, the word for those who have nothing (6:20). It is the same woman.

decisions.choice: truly: in truth
decisions.reason: Luke has the ordinary word for "truly" here, not the Hebrew word amen, as in 9:27. The force is the same.

decisions.choice: more than all: more than all the others put together
alternatives: more than any one of them
decisions.reason: Jesus measures the gift by what it cost her, as 21:4 explains. Her two coins were more than all the rich gave.

decisions.choice: {{units:two pennies|two lepta}} (B); {{units:two cents|two lepta}} (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the modern smallest coin by default, with the original coin as the alternative, as 12:59 does. Literal keeps the original coin.

decisions.choice: Truly I tell you (L, B); I tell you the truth (R)
alternatives: In truth I say to you
decisions.reason: Luke's usual rendering of this formula, as in 4:24.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and closes at the end of 21:4
alternatives: a separate quotation for each sentence
decisions.reason: Jesus' words in 21:3-4 are one saying.

decisions.choice: plural_you spans on every plural "you" and verb (les|os), from here to the end of the chapter
decisions.reason: Spanish has two plural forms of "you", Latin American "ustedes" (the default) and Peninsular "vosotros"; the reader setting chooses between them. English has no such choice, so these spans have no English counterpart.

decisions.choice: {{units:dos moneditas de cobre|dos leptones}} (B); {{units:dos monedas de muy poco valor|dos leptones}} (R)
decisions.reason: The lepton was the smallest coin in use (meaning decision m1). Spanish has no single coin word that every reader shares, as the English "pennies" and "cents" are, so the default says what the coins were; "leptones" is the alternative, and Literal keeps it, as in Mark 12:42.

decisions.choice: {{units:deux centimes|deux leptes}} (B); {{units:deux pièces d’un centime|deux leptes}} (R)
decisions.reason: The English default is the smallest US or British coin; French uses the smallest coin French readers handle, the centime, with the original coin as the alternative. Literal keeps "deux leptes".

decisions.choice: {{units:sarafu mbili ndogo za shaba|lepta mbili}} (B); {{units:sarafu mbili zenye thamani ndogo kabisa|lepta mbili}} (R)
decisions.reason: The lepton was the smallest coin in use (meaning decision m1). The default says what the coins were, with "lepta" as the alternative, as in Mark 12:42; "senti" would put a modern currency in the story. Literal keeps the coins.

decisions.choice: Kweli nawaambia (L, B); Nawaambia ukweli (R)
decisions.reason: The wording used for Jesus's single "amen" across the New Testament drafts (meaning decision m3), here and in 21:32: plain modern Swahili rather than the borrowed "Amin".

decisions.choice: "hai đồng lép-ta" (L, and the alternative in B, R); their worth as the B, R default
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:42; the Vietnamese units setting gives a modern description by default and the Greek coins as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "Thật vậy, Ta nói với các con" (L, B); "Ta nói thật với các con" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Vietnamese form for "Truly I tell you", used here for alethos as the English uses the same words (also 21:32).

source.text: πάντες γὰρ οὗτοι ἐκ τοῦ περισσεύοντος αὐτοῖς ἔβαλον εἰς τὰ δῶρα, αὕτη δὲ ἐκ τοῦ ὑστερήματος αὐτῆς πάντα τὸν βίον ὃν εἶχεν ἔβαλεν.

records.literal_gloss: All for these out of the abounding to them cast into the gifts, she however out of the lack of her all the livelihood that she had cast.

en.L: For all these put [gifts] into the offering out of what they had to spare, but she out of her lack put in all the living that she had."
en.B: Every one of them gave out of their surplus. But she, out of her need, has given the whole of what she had to live on."
en.R: The rich gave only what they had left over. But she is poor, and she gave all the money she had to live on."

es.L: Porque todos estos echaron en las ofrendas de lo que les sobraba; pero ella, de su escasez, echó todo el sustento que tenía».
es.B: Todos ellos dieron de lo que les sobraba; pero ella, en su necesidad, ha dado todo lo que tenía para vivir».
es.R: Los ricos dieron solo lo que les sobraba. Pero ella es pobre, y dio todo el dinero que tenía para vivir».

fr.L: Car tous ceux-ci ont mis [de l’argent] dans les offrandes, de ce qu’ils avaient en surplus, mais elle, de son manque, a mis toute la subsistance qu’elle avait. »
fr.B: Tous ceux-là ont donné de ce qu’ils avaient en trop. Mais elle, qui manque de tout, a donné tout ce qu’elle avait pour vivre. »
fr.R: Les riches ont donné seulement ce qu’ils avaient en plus. Mais elle est pauvre, et elle a donné tout l’argent qu’elle avait pour vivre. »

sw.L: Kwa maana hawa wote walitia katika matoleo kutoka katika kile kilichowazidi, lakini yeye, kutoka katika upungufu wake, alitia riziki yote aliyokuwa nayo."
sw.B: Wote hao walitoa kutokana na ziada yao. Lakini yeye, katika uhitaji wake, ametoa kila kitu alichokuwa nacho cha kuishi."
sw.R: Matajiri walitoa tu kile kilichobaki baada ya mahitaji yao. Lakini yeye ni maskini, naye ametoa fedha zote alizokuwa nazo za kuishi."

vi.L: Vì tất cả những người ấy đều bỏ vào lễ vật từ của dư thừa của mình, còn bà này, từ trong sự thiếu thốn của mình, đã bỏ vào tất cả sinh kế mà bà có."
vi.B: Mọi người kia đều dâng từ phần dư thừa của mình. Còn bà, dù túng thiếu, đã dâng tất cả những gì bà có để sống."
vi.R: Những người giàu chỉ dâng phần tiền họ còn dư. Nhưng bà này nghèo, và bà đã dâng hết số tiền bà có để sống."

decisions.choice: living: the means of living, what she had to live on
decisions.reason: The word means life in the sense of a livelihood, as in 8:43 and 15:12. She gave everything she had for food and need.

decisions.choice: into the gifts: into the offering, the gifts given to God
alternatives: into the gifts the rich had brought
decisions.reason: The phrase names the offering itself. The gifts went to God through the temple.

decisions.choice: out of her lack: God values a gift by what it costs the giver, not by its size
alternatives: a rebuke of the rich for giving
decisions.reason: Jesus does not blame the rich for giving. He shows what God sees: they kept plenty, and she kept nothing (2 Corinthians 8:12).

decisions.choice: The rich
decisions.reason: Readable names who "all these" are, from 21:1.

decisions.choice: the quotation closes here
alternatives: a separate quotation for each sentence
decisions.reason: The saying begun in 21:3 ends.

decisions.choice: "sinh kế" (L); "những gì bà có để sống" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means what she had to live on (meaning decision).

source.text: Καί τινων λεγόντων περὶ τοῦ ἱεροῦ, ὅτι λίθοις καλοῖς καὶ ἀναθήμασιν κεκόσμηται εἶπεν·

records.literal_gloss: And some speaking about the temple, that with stones beautiful and offerings it had been adorned, he said,

en.L: And as some were speaking about the temple, that it was adorned with beautiful stones and offerings, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said,
en.B: Some people were talking about the temple: how fine its stones were, and how it was decorated with gifts given to God. Jesus said,
en.R: Some people were talking about the temple. They spoke about how beautiful its stones were, and about the gifts people had given to make it beautiful. Jesus said,

es.L: Y como algunos hablaban del templo, de que estaba adornado con hermosas piedras y ofrendas, dijo:
es.B: Algunos comentaban acerca del templo, de lo bellas que eran sus piedras y de los dones ofrecidos a Dios que lo adornaban. Jesús dijo:
es.R: Algunas personas hablaban del templo. Comentaban lo hermosas que eran sus piedras, y los regalos que la gente había dado para adornarlo. Jesús dijo:

fr.L: Et comme quelques-uns disaient du temple qu’il était orné de belles pierres et d’offrandes, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit :
fr.B: Certains parlaient du temple, de la beauté de ses pierres et des dons offerts à Dieu qui le décoraient. Jésus dit :
fr.R: Des gens parlaient du temple. Ils disaient que ses pierres étaient très belles. Ils parlaient aussi des cadeaux que des gens avaient donnés pour le rendre beau. Jésus a dit :

sw.L: Na wengine walipokuwa wakisema habari za hekalu, kwamba limepambwa kwa mawe mazuri na vitu vilivyotolewa wakfu, alisema,
sw.B: Baadhi ya watu walikuwa wakizungumza juu ya hekalu, jinsi mawe yake yalivyokuwa mazuri, na jinsi lilivyopambwa kwa zawadi zilizotolewa kwa Mungu. Yesu akasema,
sw.R: Watu fulani walikuwa wakizungumza juu ya hekalu. Walisema habari za mawe yake mazuri, na za zawadi ambazo watu walikuwa wametoa ili kulipamba. Yesu akasema,

vi.L: Và khi có mấy người nói về đền thờ, rằng nó được trang hoàng bằng những đá đẹp và những lễ vật, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói:
vi.B: Có mấy người đang nói về đền thờ: đá của đền thờ đẹp biết bao, và đền thờ được trang hoàng bằng những lễ vật dâng cho Đức Chúa Trời. Đức Giê-xu nói:
vi.R: Có mấy người đang nói chuyện về đền thờ. Họ nói những tảng đá của đền thờ thật đẹp, và những món quà người ta dâng làm cho đền thờ thêm đẹp. Đức Giê-xu nói:

decisions.choice: the temple and its beautiful stones: the temple Herod the Great rebuilt on a grand scale
alternatives: the first temple built by Solomon
decisions.reason: Herod's rebuilding of the temple began about twenty years before Jesus was born and was still going on in his day (John 2:20). It was built of huge, fine stones and was famous for its beauty.

decisions.choice: offerings: gifts dedicated to God and put on display in the temple
decisions.reason: The word means something set up as a gift to God. Such gifts were hung or set up in the temple for people to see. The Jewish historian Josephus describes a golden vine at the entrance of the sanctuary.

decisions.choice: some: people who were there, not named
decisions.reason: Luke does not say who was speaking. In Mark 13:1 it is one of the disciples.

decisions.choice: Jesus said
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the speaker.

decisions.choice: le temple at every level here
alternatives: la cour du temple (B, R), as in 2:27
decisions.reason: Here the buildings themselves, their stones and ornaments, are meant (m1), so Balanced and Readable say "le temple"; "la cour du temple" is kept for the courts where people gather and Jesus teaches (21:37-38).

decisions.choice: "đền thờ" at every level here
decisions.reason: The speakers admire the temple building itself, so Balanced and Readable keep "đền thờ" rather than "sân đền thờ" (the courts, 21:37-38).

source.text: Ταῦτα ἃ θεωρεῖτε, ἐλεύσονται ἡμέραι ἐν αἷς οὐκ ἀφεθήσεται λίθος ἐπὶ λίθῳ ὃς οὐ καταλυθήσεται.

records.literal_gloss: These things which you are looking at, will come days in which not will be left stone upon stone which not will be thrown down.

en.L: "[As for] these things that you are looking at, days will come in which a stone will not be left upon a stone that will not be thrown down."
en.B: "You are looking at all this. But days are coming when it will all be torn down, and not a stone will stay standing on another."
en.R: "You see all these buildings. But a day is coming when every stone here will be pulled down. Not even two stones will be left one on top of the other."

es.L: «[En cuanto a] esto que {{plural_you:contemplan|contempláis}}, llegarán días en los que no se dejará piedra sobre piedra que no sea derribada».
es.B: «Todo esto lo {{plural_you:están mirando|estáis mirando}} ahora. Pero vienen días en que todo será derribado, y no quedará en pie ni una piedra sobre otra».
es.R: «{{plural_you:Ven|Veis}} todos estos edificios. Pero llegará un día en que cada piedra de aquí será echada abajo. No quedarán ni dos piedras una encima de la otra».

fr.L: « [Quant à] ces choses que vous regardez, des jours viendront où il ne sera pas laissé pierre sur pierre qui ne soit renversée. »
fr.B: « Vous regardez tout cela. Mais des jours viennent où tout sera démoli, et il ne restera pas une pierre debout sur une autre. »
fr.R: « Vous voyez tous ces bâtiments. Mais un jour viendra où toutes les pierres d’ici seront jetées à terre. Il ne restera même pas deux pierres l’une sur l’autre. »

sw.L: "[Kuhusu] haya mnayoyatazama, zitakuja siku ambazo hakuna jiwe litakaloachwa juu ya jiwe bila kubomolewa."
sw.B: "Haya yote mnayatazama sasa. Lakini siku zinakuja ambapo yote yatabomolewa, wala hakuna jiwe litakalobaki juu ya jingine."
sw.R: "Mnaona majengo haya yote. Lakini siku moja kila jiwe la hapa litaangushwa chini. Hata mawe mawili hayatabaki moja juu ya jingine."

vi.L: "[Còn] những điều các con đang nhìn đây, sẽ có những ngày mà không một hòn đá nào được để lại trên hòn đá [khác] mà không bị phá đổ."
vi.B: "Các con đang nhìn ngắm những thứ này. Nhưng sẽ đến những ngày tất cả đều bị phá đổ, không có một hòn đá nào còn nằm trên một hòn đá khác."
vi.R: "Các con thấy tất cả những tòa nhà này. Nhưng sẽ đến một ngày mọi hòn đá ở đây đều bị phá sập. Sẽ không còn hai hòn đá nào nằm chồng lên nhau."

decisions.choice: the temple will be completely destroyed
decisions.reason: This happened in AD 70, when a Roman army destroyed Jerusalem and burned the temple. Jesus had already wept over the city and said the same of it (19:44).

decisions.choice: these things that you are looking at: a phrase set first for emphasis, with no verb of its own
alternatives: a question: are you looking at these things?
decisions.reason: The phrase stands at the head of the sentence and the rest of the sentence tells what will happen to it.

decisions.choice: You are looking at all this. (B); You see all these buildings. (R)
alternatives: As for these things you are looking at
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the opening phrase a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens and closes in this record
alternatives: a separate quotation for each sentence
decisions.reason: Jesus' answer is one sentence.

source.text: Ἐπηρώτησαν δὲ αὐτὸν λέγοντες· Διδάσκαλε, πότε οὖν ταῦτα ἔσται, καὶ τί τὸ σημεῖον ὅταν μέλλῃ ταῦτα γίνεσθαι;

records.literal_gloss: They asked then him saying, Teacher, when then these things will be, and what the sign when are about these things to take place?

en.L: And they asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, saying, "Teacher, when then will these things be, and what [will be] the sign when these things are about to take place?"
en.B: They put a question to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}: "Teacher, when will these things be? And what sign will there be when they are about to take place?"
en.R: So they asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Teacher, when will these things happen? What sign will show us that they are about to happen?"

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron, diciendo: «Maestro, ¿cuándo, pues, sucederán estas cosas, y cuál [será] la señal de cuando estas cosas estén a punto de suceder?».
es.B: Entonces {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} hicieron una pregunta: «Maestro, ¿cuándo será todo esto? ¿Y qué señal habrá cuando esté a punto de suceder?».
es.R: Así que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron: «Maestro, ¿cuándo pasará esto? ¿Qué señal nos mostrará que está a punto de pasar?».

fr.L: Et ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}interrogèrent, disant : « Maître, quand donc ces choses seront-elles, et quel [sera] le signe quand ces choses seront sur le point d’arriver ? »
fr.B: Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} posèrent cette question : « Maître, quand cela arrivera-t-il ? Et quel signe y aura-t-il quand cela sera sur le point de se produire ? »
fr.R: Alors ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont demandé : « Maître, quand est-ce que cela va arriver ? Quel signe nous montrera que cela va bientôt se produire ? »

sw.L: Wakamwuliza, wakisema, "Mwalimu, basi mambo haya yatakuwa lini, na [itakuwa] ishara gani wakati mambo haya yatakapokaribia kutokea?"
sw.B: Wakamwuliza swali: "Mwalimu, mambo haya yatatokea lini? Na kutakuwa na ishara gani yatakapokaribia kutokea?"
sw.R: Kwa hiyo wakamwuliza, "Mwalimu, mambo haya yatatokea lini? Ni ishara gani itakayotuonyesha kwamba yanakaribia kutokea?"

vi.L: Và họ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rằng: "Thưa Thầy, vậy khi nào những điều này sẽ xảy ra, và [sẽ có] dấu hiệu gì khi những điều này sắp xảy đến?"
vi.B: Họ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Thầy, khi nào những việc ấy sẽ xảy ra? Và khi những việc ấy sắp xảy đến thì sẽ có dấu hiệu gì?"
vi.R: Vì vậy họ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Thầy, khi nào những việc ấy sẽ xảy ra? Dấu hiệu nào sẽ cho chúng con biết rằng những việc ấy sắp xảy ra?"

decisions.choice: sign: a visible event that shows that something is near
decisions.reason: They ask for a sign that will tell them the time. Jesus answers with signs in 21:11 and 21:25.

decisions.choice: these things: the destruction of the temple Jesus has just foretold (21:6)
decisions.reason: The question is about the temple. Jesus' answer runs on from the city's fall to the coming of the Son of Man (21:20-28).

decisions.choice: "Thưa Thầy"; "dấu hiệu" for the sign
decisions.reason: As in Mark 13:1-4; "dấu hiệu" is a sign that something is near (meaning decision), not a miracle.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν· Βλέπετε μὴ πλανηθῆτε· πολλοὶ γὰρ ἐλεύσονται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου λέγοντες· Ἐγώ εἰμι καί· Ὁ καιρὸς ἤγγικεν· μὴ πορευθῆτε ὀπίσω αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: And he said, Watch out lest you be led astray; many for will come in the name of me saying, I am, and, The time has drawn near; not go after them.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "See that you are not led astray, for many will come in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, saying, 'I am [he],' and, 'The time has come near.' Do not go after them.
en.B: He answered, "Take care that no one leads you astray. Many will come claiming {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name and saying, 'I am the one!' and, 'The time has come near!' Do not go after them.
en.R: Jesus said, "Be careful! Do not let anyone fool you. Many people will come and use {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name. They will say, 'I am the one you are waiting for!' They will say, 'The time has come!' Do not follow them.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dijo: «{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}} que no {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} engañados; porque muchos vendrán en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, diciendo: “Yo soy”, y: “El tiempo se ha acercado”. No {{plural_you:vayan|vayáis}} tras ellos.
es.B: Él respondió: «{{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado de que nadie {{plural_you:los|os}} extravíe. Muchos vendrán reclamando {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre y diciendo: “¡Yo soy él!”, y: “¡El tiempo se ha acercado!”. No {{plural_you:vayan|vayáis}} tras ellos.
es.R: Jesús dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado! No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que nadie {{plural_you:los|os}} engañe. Mucha gente vendrá y usará {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre. Dirán: “¡Yo soy el que {{plural_you:ustedes esperan|vosotros esperáis}}!”. Dirán: “¡Ha llegado el tiempo!”. No los {{plural_you:sigan|sigáis}}.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « Prenez garde de ne pas être égarés ; car beaucoup viendront en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, disant : “Je [le] suis”, et : “Le moment s’est approché.” N’allez pas derrière eux.
fr.B: Il répondit : « Faites attention que personne ne vous égare. Beaucoup viendront en se réclamant de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et ils diront : “C’est moi !” et : “Le moment est proche !” Ne les suivez pas.
fr.R: Jésus a dit : « Faites attention ! Ne laissez personne vous tromper. Beaucoup de gens viendront et se serviront de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom. Ils diront : “C’est moi, celui que vous attendez !” Ils diront : “Le moment est arrivé !” Ne les suivez pas.

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Angalieni msidanganywe; kwa maana wengi watakuja kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, wakisema, 'Mimi ndiye,' na, 'Wakati umekaribia.' Msiende nyuma yao.
sw.B: Akajibu, "Jihadharini mtu asiwapotoshe. Wengi watakuja wakilidai jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} na kusema, 'Mimi ndiye!' na, 'Wakati umekaribia!' Msiwafuate.
sw.R: Yesu akasema, "Jihadharini! Msikubali mtu yeyote awadanganye. Watu wengi watakuja wakitumia jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}. Watasema, 'Mimi ndiye yule mnayemngojea!' Watasema, 'Wakati umefika!' Msiwafuate.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Hãy coi chừng, kẻo các con bị lừa dối; vì nhiều kẻ sẽ đến nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, nói rằng: 'Ta là [Đấng ấy],' và: 'Thời điểm đã đến gần.' Đừng đi theo họ.
vi.B: Ngài đáp: "Hãy đề phòng, đừng để ai lừa gạt các con. Nhiều kẻ sẽ mạo danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà đến và nói: 'Ta chính là Đấng ấy!' và: 'Thời điểm đã gần rồi!' Đừng đi theo họ.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói: "Hãy cẩn thận! Đừng để ai lừa các con. Nhiều người sẽ đến và dùng danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Họ sẽ nói: 'Ta là Đấng các người đang trông đợi!' Họ sẽ nói: 'Thời điểm đã đến rồi!' Đừng đi theo họ.

decisions.choice: in my name: claiming my name and title for themselves
decisions.reason: They will come as if they were Jesus, or as if they had his authority. The next words show they claim to be the one Israel was waiting for.

decisions.choice: I am: I am he, the one who was promised
decisions.reason: The words are a claim to be the Messiah, the one expected. False leaders of this kind did appear in the years before Jerusalem fell (Acts 5:36-37).

decisions.choice: the time: the time of the end, the time God has set
decisions.reason: The word means a fixed time or season. The false teachers will claim the end has come.

decisions.choice: I am the one you are waiting for!
decisions.reason: Readable says who they claim to be, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and closes at the end of 21:9
alternatives: a separate quotation for each sentence
decisions.reason: The words of 21:8-9 are one answer. Luke then starts again with "Then he said to them" (21:10).

decisions.choice: Yo soy (L); ¡Yo soy él! (B); ¡Yo soy el que ustedes esperan! (R)
decisions.reason: Spanish "Yo soy" can stand alone, so Literal supplies nothing and keeps the bare claim (meaning decision m2), as in Mark 13:6. Balanced adds "él"; Readable says who they claim to be, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Mimi ndiye (L, B); Mimi ndiye yule mnayemngojea (R), with nothing in brackets
decisions.reason: "Mimi ni" cannot end a sentence in Swahili. "Ndiye" already means "I am he, I am the one" (meaning decision m2), so Literal needs no bracket for the English "[he]", as in Mark 13:6; Readable says who they claim to be, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Hãy coi chừng" (L), "Hãy đề phòng" (B), "Hãy cẩn thận" (R); 'Ta là [Đấng ấy]' (L), 'Ta chính là Đấng ấy' (B)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 13:5-6. The false claimants' "Ta" opens their quoted words and takes no span.

source.text: ὅταν δὲ ἀκούσητε πολέμους καὶ ἀκαταστασίας, μὴ πτοηθῆτε· δεῖ γὰρ ταῦτα γενέσθαι πρῶτον, ἀλλ’ οὐκ εὐθέως τὸ τέλος.

records.literal_gloss: When then you hear of wars and uprisings, not be terrified; it is necessary for these things to take place first, but not immediately the end.

en.L: And when you hear of wars and uprisings, do not be terrified; for these things must take place first, but the end [is] not immediately."
en.B: When you hear about wars and rebellions, do not panic. All this has to happen first, but it does not mean that the end comes at once."
en.R: You will hear about wars and about people fighting against their rulers. Do not be afraid. These things must happen first. But the end will not come right after them."

es.L: Y cuando {{plural_you:oigan|oigáis}} de guerras y revueltas, no {{plural_you:se aterroricen|os aterroricéis}}; porque es necesario que estas cosas sucedan primero, pero el fin [no vendrá] enseguida».
es.B: Cuando {{plural_you:oigan|oigáis}} hablar de guerras y rebeliones, no {{plural_you:se asusten|os asustéis}}. Todo eso tiene que pasar primero, pero eso no significa que el fin llegue enseguida».
es.R: {{plural_you:Oirán|Oiréis}} de guerras y de gente que se rebela contra sus gobernantes. No {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo. Estas cosas tienen que pasar primero. Pero el fin no vendrá inmediatamente después».

fr.L: Et quand vous entendrez parler de guerres et de soulèvements, ne soyez pas terrifiés ; car il faut que ces choses arrivent d’abord, mais [ce ne sera] pas aussitôt la fin. »
fr.B: Quand vous entendrez parler de guerres et de révoltes, ne vous affolez pas. Tout cela doit arriver d’abord, mais cela ne veut pas dire que la fin viendra tout de suite. »
fr.R: Vous entendrez parler de guerres, et de gens qui se révoltent contre leurs chefs. N’ayez pas peur. Ces choses doivent arriver d’abord. Mais la fin ne viendra pas tout de suite après. »

sw.L: Na mtakaposikia vita na machafuko, msitishwe; kwa maana ni lazima mambo haya yatokee kwanza, lakini mwisho [hautakuja] mara moja."
sw.B: Mtakaposikia habari za vita na maasi, msifadhaike. Hayo yote lazima yatokee kwanza, lakini haimaanishi kwamba mwisho utakuja mara moja."
sw.R: Mtasikia habari za vita, na za watu wanaowaasi watawala wao. Msiogope. Mambo hayo lazima yatokee kwanza. Lakini mwisho hautakuja mara tu baada ya hayo."

vi.L: Và khi các con nghe về chiến tranh và loạn lạc, đừng kinh hãi; vì những điều này phải xảy ra trước, nhưng sự cuối cùng [đến] không phải ngay lập tức."
vi.B: Khi các con nghe nói về chiến tranh và nổi loạn, đừng hoảng hốt. Những việc ấy phải xảy ra trước, nhưng không có nghĩa là lúc cuối cùng đến ngay."
vi.R: Các con sẽ nghe về những cuộc chiến tranh và những cuộc nổi dậy chống lại nhà cầm quyền. Đừng sợ hãi. Những việc ấy phải xảy ra trước. Nhưng thời điểm cuối cùng sẽ chưa đến ngay sau đó."

decisions.choice: uprisings: revolts, disorder in the land
decisions.reason: The word means unrest and rebellion, people rising against those who rule them.

decisions.choice: must: it is part of God's plan
decisions.reason: The same word is used of what must happen to the Son of Man (9:22). These things do not happen outside God's purpose.

decisions.choice: the end: the end of the age
alternatives: the end of the temple only
decisions.reason: Wars do not mean that the last day has come. There will be more to happen first (21:12, 24).

decisions.choice: the quotation closes here
alternatives: a separate quotation for each sentence
decisions.reason: Luke's narration interrupts in 21:10.

decisions.choice: "sự cuối cùng" (L); "lúc cuối cùng" (B); "thời điểm cuối cùng" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 13:7.

source.text: τότε ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς· Ἐγερθήσεται ἔθνος ἐπ’ ἔθνος καὶ βασιλεία ἐπὶ βασιλείαν, σεισμοί τε μεγάλοι καὶ κατὰ τόπους λιμοὶ καὶ λοιμοὶ ἔσονται, φόβητρά τε καὶ σημεῖα ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ μεγάλα ἔσται.

records.literal_gloss: Then he was saying to them, Will rise up nation against nation and kingdom against kingdom, \v 11 earthquakes both great and in places famines and plagues there will be, terrors both and signs from heaven great there will be.

en.L: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom, \v 11 and there will be great earthquakes, and famines and plagues in various places; and there will be terrors and great signs from heaven.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went on to tell them, "One nation will go to war with another, and one kingdom with another. \v 11 There will be powerful earthquakes, and in place after place famines and diseases. Fearful things will happen, and great signs will appear in the sky.
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Nations will fight against each other. Kingdoms will fight against each other. \v 11 There will be strong earthquakes. In many places people will go hungry and get sick. Terrible things will happen, and there will be great signs in the sky.

es.L: Entonces les decía: «Se levantará nación contra nación y reino contra reino, \v 11 y habrá grandes terremotos, y en diversos lugares hambres y pestes; y habrá terrores y grandes señales del cielo.
es.B: Luego siguió diciéndoles: «Una nación entrará en guerra contra otra, y un reino contra otro. \v 11 Habrá terremotos violentos, y en un lugar tras otro hambres y epidemias. Sucederán cosas espantosas, y aparecerán grandes señales en el cielo.
es.R: Después les dijo: «Las naciones pelearán unas contra otras. Los reinos pelearán unos contra otros. \v 11 Habrá terremotos fuertes. En muchos lugares la gente pasará hambre y se enfermará. Pasarán cosas terribles, y habrá grandes señales en el cielo.

fr.L: Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur disait : « Nation se dressera contre nation, et royaume contre royaume ; \v 11 et il y aura de grands tremblements de terre, et par endroits des famines et des pestes ; et il y aura des terreurs et de grands signes venant du ciel.
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} poursuivit : « Une nation entrera en guerre contre une autre, et un royaume contre un autre. \v 11 Il y aura de violents tremblements de terre et, d’un endroit à l’autre, des famines et des épidémies. Des événements effrayants se produiront, et de grands signes apparaîtront dans le ciel.
fr.R: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur a dit : « Les peuples se battront les uns contre les autres. Les royaumes se battront les uns contre les autres. \v 11 Il y aura de forts tremblements de terre. Dans beaucoup d’endroits, les gens n’auront pas assez à manger, et ils tomberont malades. Des choses terribles arriveront, et il y aura de grands signes dans le ciel.

sw.L: Kisha alikuwa akiwaambia, "Taifa litainuka dhidi ya taifa, na ufalme dhidi ya ufalme; \v 11 na kutakuwa na matetemeko makubwa ya ardhi, na njaa na tauni mahali mbalimbali; na kutakuwa na vitisho na ishara kubwa kutoka mbinguni.
sw.B: Kisha akaendelea kuwaambia, "Taifa moja litapigana na taifa jingine, na ufalme mmoja na ufalme mwingine. \v 11 Kutakuwa na matetemeko makubwa ya ardhi, na mahali pamoja baada ya pengine njaa na magonjwa ya kuambukiza. Mambo ya kutisha yatatokea, na ishara kubwa zitaonekana angani.
sw.R: Kisha akawaambia, "Mataifa yatapigana. Falme zitapigana. \v 11 Kutakuwa na matetemeko makubwa ya ardhi. Mahali pengi watu watakuwa na njaa na kuugua. Mambo ya kutisha yatatokea, na kutakuwa na ishara kubwa angani.

vi.L: Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Dân tộc sẽ nổi lên chống lại dân tộc, và vương quốc chống lại vương quốc; \v 11 sẽ có những trận động đất lớn, và đói kém và dịch bệnh ở nhiều nơi; sẽ có những điều kinh hoàng và những dấu hiệu lớn từ trời.
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói tiếp với họ: "Dân tộc này sẽ giao chiến với dân tộc khác, vương quốc này với vương quốc khác. \v 11 Sẽ có những trận động đất dữ dội, nhiều nơi sẽ có đói kém và dịch bệnh. Sẽ có những việc kinh hoàng, và những dấu hiệu lớn xuất hiện trên bầu trời.
vi.R: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Các dân tộc sẽ đánh nhau. Các vương quốc sẽ đánh nhau. \v 11 Sẽ có những trận động đất mạnh. Ở nhiều nơi người ta sẽ bị đói và bị bệnh. Sẽ có những việc khủng khiếp xảy ra, và sẽ có những dấu hiệu lớn trên bầu trời.

decisions.choice: nation will rise against nation: peoples will go to war with one another
decisions.reason: The words echo the prophets' pictures of nations at war (2 Chronicles 15:6; Isaiah 19:2).

decisions.choice: famines and plagues: lack of food and deadly disease
decisions.reason: The two Greek words sound almost the same, and Luke puts them side by side. Hunger and disease often came together.

decisions.choice: from heaven: from the sky
decisions.reason: The word can mean the sky or the place where God is. Here it is where the signs are seen, as in 21:25.

decisions.choice: in the sky
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say where the signs will be seen, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and runs on to 21:28
alternatives: a separate quotation for each sentence
decisions.reason: Jesus' words in 21:10-28 are one speech.

decisions.choice: du ciel (L); dans le ciel (B, R)
decisions.reason: French "le ciel" means both the sky and heaven, so one word serves every level; English Literal "from heaven" and Balanced "in the sky" (m3) need no different French nouns.

decisions.choice: "từ trời" (L); "trên bầu trời" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Heaven" here is the sky (meaning decision).

source.text: Πρὸ δὲ τούτων πάντων ἐπιβαλοῦσιν ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν καὶ διώξουσιν, παραδιδόντες εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς καὶ φυλακάς, ἀπαγομένους ἐπὶ βασιλεῖς καὶ ἡγεμόνας ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματός μου·

records.literal_gloss: Before however these things all they will lay upon you the hands of them and will persecute, delivering to the synagogues and prisons, being led before kings and governors on account of the name of me;

en.L: But before all these things they will lay their hands on you and persecute [you], handing [you] over to the synagogues and prisons, [and you will be] led away before kings and governors because of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name.
en.B: Before all that, however, they will arrest you and hunt you down. They will hand you over to synagogues and to prisons, and you will be led off to stand before kings and governors for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name.
en.R: But before all this happens, people will grab you and treat you cruelly. They will take you to the synagogues to be judged, and they will put you in prison. They will drag you in front of kings and rulers, because you follow {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Pero antes de todas estas cosas pondrán sus manos sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y {{plural_you:los|os}} perseguirán, {{plural_you:entregándolos|entregándoos}} a las sinagogas y cárceles, siendo llevados ante reyes y gobernadores por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre.
es.B: Pero antes de todo eso, {{plural_you:los|os}} arrestarán y {{plural_you:los|os}} perseguirán. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} entregarán a las sinagogas y a las cárceles, y {{plural_you:los|os}} llevarán ante reyes y gobernadores por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre.
es.R: Pero antes de que pase todo esto, la gente {{plural_you:los|os}} agarrará y {{plural_you:los|os}} tratará con crueldad. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} llevarán a las sinagogas para {{plural_you:juzgarlos|juzgaros}}, y {{plural_you:los|os}} meterán en la cárcel. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} arrastrarán ante reyes y gobernantes, porque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}}.

fr.L: Mais avant tout cela, ils mettront les mains sur vous et [vous] persécuteront, [vous] livrant aux synagogues et aux prisons, [et vous serez] emmenés devant des rois et des gouverneurs à cause de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom.
fr.B: Mais avant tout cela, on vous arrêtera et on vous persécutera. On vous livrera aux synagogues, on vous jettera en prison, et l’on vous emmènera devant des rois et des gouverneurs à cause de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom.
fr.R: Mais avant que tout cela arrive, des gens vous attraperont et vous feront souffrir. Ils vous emmèneront dans les synagogues pour vous juger, et ils vous mettront en prison. Ils vous traîneront devant des rois et des dirigeants, parce que vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suivez.

sw.L: Lakini kabla ya mambo haya yote watawanyooshea mikono yao na kuwatesa, wakiwakabidhi kwa masinagogi na magereza, mkipelekwa mbele ya wafalme na wakuu wa mikoa kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.
sw.B: Lakini kabla ya hayo yote watawakamata na kuwatesa. Watawakabidhi kwa masinagogi na kuwatia magerezani, nanyi mtapelekwa mbele ya wafalme na wakuu wa mikoa kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.
sw.R: Lakini kabla ya mambo haya yote kutokea, watu watawakamata na kuwatendea kwa ukatili. Watawapeleka katika masinagogi ili mhukumiwe, na watawatia gerezani. Watawaburuta mbele ya wafalme na watawala, kwa sababu mnanifuata.

vi.L: Nhưng trước tất cả những điều này, người ta sẽ tra tay trên các con và bắt bớ [các con], nộp [các con] cho các nhà hội và vào ngục, giải [các con] đến trước các vua và các quan tổng đốc vì danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Nhưng trước khi những điều ấy xảy ra, người ta sẽ bắt các con và bắt bớ các con. Họ sẽ nộp các con cho các nhà hội và tống vào ngục, và các con sẽ bị giải đến trước các vua và các quan tổng đốc vì danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Nhưng trước khi những việc ấy xảy ra, người ta sẽ bắt các con và đối xử tàn nhẫn với các con. Họ sẽ đưa các con đến các nhà hội để xét xử, và bỏ các con vào tù. Họ sẽ lôi các con đến trước các vua và các nhà cầm quyền, vì các con theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

decisions.choice: lay their hands on you: arrest you
decisions.reason: To lay hands on someone is to seize them (20:19; Acts 4:3).

decisions.choice: synagogues: the local Jewish assemblies, which also judged and punished their members
decisions.reason: Synagogue leaders could have a member beaten (Acts 22:19; 2 Corinthians 11:24).

decisions.choice: before kings and governors: as happened to the apostles
decisions.reason: In Acts the apostles are arrested and put on trial, and Paul stands before the governors Felix and Festus and King Agrippa (Acts 4:3; 24-26).

decisions.choice: because of my name: because you belong to me and bear my name
alternatives: because you use my name in magic
decisions.reason: The name stands for the person. They will suffer for being his followers (Acts 5:41).

decisions.choice: to be judged; because you follow me
alternatives: to the synagogues; because of my name
decisions.reason: Readable says why they are taken to the synagogues and what "because of my name" means, as the meaning decisions explain.

decisions.choice: wakuu wa mikoa (L, B); watawala (R)
decisions.reason: The term used for the Roman governors across the New Testament drafts, as in John 18-19; Readable says "watawala" (rulers), as the English Readable says "rulers".

decisions.choice: "nộp" for "hand over"; "các quan tổng đốc" (L, B), "các nhà cầm quyền" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 13:9 and Matthew 10:18.

decisions.choice: "tra tay trên các con" (L); "bắt" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the idiom, as in 20:19; it means to arrest (meaning decision).

source.text: ἀποβήσεται ὑμῖν εἰς μαρτύριον.

records.literal_gloss: It will turn out to you for a testimony.

en.L: This will turn out for you as [an opportunity for] testimony.
en.B: This will give you the chance to bear witness.
en.R: This will be your chance to tell them about {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} resultará en [ocasión de] testimonio.
es.B: Esto {{plural_you:les|os}} dará la oportunidad de dar testimonio.
es.R: Así {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} la oportunidad de hablarles de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.

fr.L: Cela tournera pour vous en [occasion de] témoignage.
fr.B: Ce sera pour vous l’occasion de rendre témoignage.
fr.R: Ce sera pour vous l’occasion de leur parler de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: Itakuwa kwenu [nafasi ya] ushuhuda.
sw.B: Hii itawapa nafasi ya kutoa ushuhuda.
sw.R: Hiyo itakuwa nafasi yenu ya kuwaeleza habari {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}.

vi.L: Điều đó sẽ trở thành [dịp] làm chứng cho các con.
vi.B: Đó sẽ là dịp để các con làm chứng.
vi.R: Đó sẽ là dịp để các con nói cho họ biết về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

decisions.choice: for a testimony: an opportunity for you to bear witness to Jesus before them
alternatives: evidence against them at the judgment
evidence in your favor at the judgment
decisions.reason: Being put on trial will let them speak about Jesus before rulers, as the next verses go on to say (21:14-15) and as Acts shows. Some read it as a witness against the persecutors, as in 9:5.

decisions.choice: to tell them about me
decisions.reason: Readable says what the testimony is about.

source.text: θέτε οὖν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν μὴ προμελετᾶν ἀπολογηθῆναι, ἐγὼ γὰρ δώσω ὑμῖν στόμα καὶ σοφίαν ᾗ οὐ δυνήσονται ἀντιστῆναι ἢ ἀντειπεῖν ἅπαντες οἱ ἀντικείμενοι ὑμῖν.

records.literal_gloss: Put therefore in the hearts of you not to prepare beforehand to make a defense, \v 15 I for will give you a mouth and wisdom which not will be able to resist or to contradict all those opposing you.

en.L: So set [it] in your hearts not to prepare beforehand how to make a defense, \v 15 for I will give you a mouth and wisdom that none of those who oppose you will be able to withstand or contradict.
en.B: So settle it in your hearts: do not plan your defense in advance. \v 15 I myself will give you the words and the wisdom to speak, and not one of your opponents will be able to stand against them or argue back.
en.R: So decide now that you will not plan ahead what to say to defend yourselves. \v 15 I will give you the right words to say. I will make you wise. None of your enemies will be able to stand against you or prove you wrong.

es.L: {{plural_you:Pongan|Poned}}, pues, en {{plural_you:sus corazones|vuestros corazones}} no preparar de antemano cómo {{plural_you:defenderse|defenderos}}, \v 15 porque yo {{plural_you:les|os}} daré boca y sabiduría a la que no podrán resistir ni contradecir todos los que se {{plural_you:les|os}} oponen.
es.B: Así que {{plural_you:tomen|tomad}} la firme decisión de no preparar de antemano {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} defensa. \v 15 Yo mismo {{plural_you:les|os}} daré las palabras y la sabiduría, y ninguno de {{plural_you:sus adversarios|vuestros adversarios}} podrá hacerles frente ni contradecirlas.
es.R: Así que {{plural_you:decidan|decidid}} desde ahora que no {{plural_you:van|vais}} a planear qué decir para {{plural_you:defenderse|defenderos}}. \v 15 Yo {{plural_you:les|os}} daré las palabras justas que {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} decir. Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} haré sabios. Ninguno de {{plural_you:sus enemigos|vuestros enemigos}} podrá {{plural_you:hacerles frente|haceros frente}} ni demostrar que {{plural_you:están|estáis}} equivocados.

fr.L: Mettez donc dans vos cœurs de ne pas préparer d’avance votre défense, \v 15 car {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je vous donnerai une bouche et une sagesse qu’aucun de ceux qui s’opposent à vous ne pourra ni contrer ni contredire.
fr.B: Prenez donc fermement la décision de ne pas préparer votre défense à l’avance. \v 15 C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui vous donnerai les paroles et la sagesse pour parler, et aucun de vos adversaires ne pourra leur résister ni les contredire.
fr.R: Alors décidez dès maintenant de ne pas préparer à l’avance ce que vous direz pour vous défendre. \v 15 Je vous donnerai les bons mots à dire. Je vous rendrai sages. Aucun de vos ennemis ne pourra vous résister ni montrer que vous avez tort.

sw.L: Basi wekeni mioyoni mwenu kutojiandaa mapema jinsi ya kujitetea, \v 15 kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nitawapa kinywa na hekima ambayo wote wanaowapinga hawataweza kuipinga wala kuijibu.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo kusudieni mioyoni mwenu kwamba hamtaandaa utetezi wenu mapema. \v 15 Mimi mwenyewe nitawapa maneno na hekima ya kusema, na hakuna hata mmoja wa wapinzani wenu atakayeweza kuyapinga wala kuyajibu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo amueni sasa kwamba hamtapanga mapema mtakachosema ili kujitetea. \v 15 Nitawapa maneno yanayofaa kusema. Nitawafanya kuwa na hekima. Hakuna adui yenu yeyote atakayeweza kusimama dhidi yenu wala kuthibitisha kwamba mmekosea.

vi.L: Vậy hãy định trong lòng các con là không lo trước việc tự bào chữa, \v 15 vì chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban cho các con miệng lưỡi và sự khôn ngoan mà tất cả những kẻ chống đối các con sẽ không thể chống cự hay bác bỏ được.
vi.B: Vậy hãy quyết định trong lòng: đừng lo trước mình sẽ bào chữa thế nào. \v 15 Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban cho các con lời lẽ và sự khôn ngoan, đến nỗi không một kẻ chống đối nào có thể chống lại hay cãi lại được.
vi.R: Vậy ngay bây giờ hãy quyết định rằng các con sẽ không lo trước phải nói gì để tự bào chữa. \v 15 Ta sẽ cho các con những lời đúng để nói. Ta sẽ làm cho các con khôn ngoan. Không một kẻ thù nào của các con có thể chống lại các con hay chứng minh các con sai.

decisions.choice: set it in your hearts: make up your minds, decide firmly
decisions.reason: The heart is where a person thinks and decides. The disciples are to decide ahead of time not to rely on a prepared speech.

decisions.choice: prepare beforehand to make a defense: rehearse a speech of defense before a court
decisions.reason: The verb means to practice or prepare in advance. To make a defense is the word for speaking for oneself at a trial (12:11; Acts 26:1).

decisions.choice: a mouth: words to speak
alternatives: the power to speak at all
decisions.reason: God promised Moses to be with his mouth and teach him what to say (Exodus 4:12).

decisions.choice: I: emphatic: Jesus himself will give them the words
decisions.reason: The pronoun is written out for emphasis. In 12:12 Jesus says the Holy Spirit will teach them; both promises stand together.

decisions.choice: the words (B); the right words to say (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom.

decisions.choice: boca (L); las palabras (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture of a "mouth", meaning words to speak (meaning decision m3), as the English Literal does; Spanish "dar boca" is as unusual as the English, so Balanced and Readable say "las palabras".

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} (L), where the English "I" has no span
alternatives: mimi with no span, as the English
decisions.reason: The Greek "I" is emphatic (meaning decision m4), so Swahili writes the free pronoun "mimi", and the Swahili style guide gives Jesus's free "mimi" the setting. At Balanced it opens the sentence and takes its capital plainly; Readable leaves it in the verb (nitawapa).

decisions.choice: "miệng lưỡi" (L); "lời lẽ" (B); "những lời đúng để nói" (R)
decisions.reason: "A mouth" means words to speak (meaning decision); Literal keeps the picture in a Vietnamese idiom.

source.text: παραδοθήσεσθε δὲ καὶ ὑπὸ γονέων καὶ ἀδελφῶν καὶ συγγενῶν καὶ φίλων, καὶ θανατώσουσιν ἐξ ὑμῶν, καὶ ἔσεσθε μισούμενοι ὑπὸ πάντων διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου.

records.literal_gloss: You will be handed over then even by parents and brothers and relatives and friends, and they will put to death [some] from you, \v 17 and you will be being hated by all because of the name of me.

en.L: And you will be handed over even by parents and {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} and relatives and friends, and they will put [some] of you to death, \v 17 and you will be hated by all because of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name.
en.B: You will be handed over even by your own parents and {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, your relatives and your friends, and some of you they will kill. \v 17 You will be hated by everyone on account of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name.
en.R: Even your parents, your {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, your relatives, and your friends will turn you over to your enemies. They will kill some of you. \v 17 Everyone will hate you because you follow {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} entregados incluso por padres y hermanos y parientes y amigos, y harán morir a [algunos] de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \v 17 y {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} odiados por todos a causa de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre.
es.B: {{plural_you:Serán|Seréis}} entregados incluso por {{plural_you:sus propios padres|vuestros propios padres}} y hermanos, por {{plural_you:sus parientes|vuestros parientes}} y amigos, y a algunos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} los matarán. \v 17 Todos {{plural_you:los|os}} odiarán por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre.
es.R: Hasta {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}}, {{plural_you:sus hermanos|vuestros hermanos}}, {{plural_you:sus parientes|vuestros parientes}} y {{plural_you:sus amigos|vuestros amigos}} {{plural_you:los|os}} entregarán a {{plural_you:sus enemigos|vuestros enemigos}}. A algunos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} los matarán. \v 17 Todo el mundo {{plural_you:los|os}} odiará porque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}}.

fr.L: Et vous serez livrés même par des parents et des {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, des proches et des amis, et ils feront mourir [certains] d’entre vous, \v 17 et vous serez haïs de tous à cause de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom.
fr.B: Vous serez livrés même par vos propres parents, vos {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, votre famille et vos amis, et on fera mourir certains d’entre vous. \v 17 Tout le monde vous haïra à cause de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom.
fr.R: Même vos parents, vos {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, les gens de votre famille et vos amis vous livreront à vos ennemis. Ils tueront certains d’entre vous. \v 17 Tout le monde vous détestera parce que vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suivez.

sw.L: Nanyi mtakabidhiwa hata na wazazi na ndugu na jamaa na rafiki, nao watawaua [baadhi] yenu, \v 17 nanyi mtachukiwa na wote kwa sababu ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.
sw.B: Mtakabidhiwa hata na wazazi wenu wenyewe na ndugu zenu, na jamaa zenu na rafiki zenu, nao watawaua baadhi yenu. \v 17 Mtachukiwa na kila mtu kwa sababu ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.
sw.R: Hata wazazi wenu, ndugu zenu, jamaa zenu na rafiki zenu watawakabidhi kwa adui zenu. Watawaua baadhi yenu. \v 17 Kila mtu atawachukia kwa sababu mnanifuata.

vi.L: Các con sẽ bị nộp ngay cả bởi cha mẹ, {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, bà con và bạn hữu, và họ sẽ giết [một số] người trong các con, \v 17 và các con sẽ bị mọi người ghét vì danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Ngay cả cha mẹ, {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, bà con và bạn hữu cũng sẽ nộp các con, và họ sẽ giết một số người trong các con. \v 17 Mọi người sẽ ghét các con vì danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Ngay cả cha mẹ, {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, bà con và bạn bè của các con cũng sẽ nộp các con cho kẻ thù. Họ sẽ giết một số người trong các con. \v 17 Mọi người sẽ ghét các con vì các con theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

decisions.choice: handed over: given up to the authorities, betrayed
decisions.reason: It is the verb of 21:12 and of Judas giving Jesus up (22:4). Here it is done by one's own family.

decisions.choice: brothers: brothers and sisters, the children of one family
decisions.reason: In this list of family members the plural means the person's own brothers and sisters.

decisions.choice: of you: some of you
decisions.reason: The phrase means a part of the group: not all, but some, will be killed.

decisions.choice: because of my name: because you belong to me
decisions.reason: As in 21:12, the name stands for Jesus himself.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: The word means brothers and sisters here, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: because you follow me
decisions.reason: Readable says what "because of my name" means.

decisions.choice: hermanos, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has a gender span on "brothers". Spanish "hermanos" already means brothers and sisters, the children of one family (meaning decision m2), so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: ndugu, with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span, as the English "brothers and sisters|brothers"
decisions.reason: The English has a gender span on "brothers". Swahili "ndugu" already means brothers and sisters (meaning decision m2), so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} at every level
decisions.reason: Here siblings of one family are meant (meaning decision); the style guide's span gives the inclusive word by default, as the English gender setting does.

source.text: καὶ θρὶξ ἐκ τῆς κεφαλῆς ὑμῶν οὐ μὴ ἀπόληται.

records.literal_gloss: And a hair from the head of you not not will perish.

en.L: And not a hair of your head will perish.
en.B: Yet not a single hair of your head will be lost.
en.R: But not even one hair on your head will be destroyed.

es.L: Y de ningún modo perecerá un cabello de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} cabeza.
es.B: Sin embargo, no se perderá ni un solo cabello de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} cabeza.
es.R: Pero ni siquiera un cabello de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} cabeza será destruido.

fr.L: Et pas un cheveu de votre tête ne périra.
fr.B: Et pourtant, pas un seul cheveu de votre tête ne sera perdu.
fr.R: Mais même pas un seul de vos cheveux ne sera détruit.

sw.L: Na unywele wa kichwa chenu hautapotea kamwe.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, hata unywele mmoja wa kichwa chenu hautapotea.
sw.R: Lakini hata unywele mmoja wa vichwa vyenu hautaharibiwa.

vi.L: Nhưng một sợi tóc trên đầu các con cũng chắc chắn không bị mất.
vi.B: Thế nhưng, không một sợi tóc nào trên đầu các con sẽ bị mất.
vi.R: Nhưng ngay cả một sợi tóc trên đầu các con cũng sẽ không bị mất.

decisions.choice: not a hair will perish: you are completely safe in God's keeping, even if you are killed
alternatives: none of you will be harmed or die
decisions.reason: Jesus has just said that some will be put to death (21:16). The promise is about what is lasting: God keeps his people whole (12:4-7; 1 Samuel 14:45 uses the same picture).

decisions.choice: not a hair: a strong double negative
decisions.reason: The Greek uses two negatives together for an emphatic denial.

source.text: ἐν τῇ ὑπομονῇ ὑμῶν κτήσασθε τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: In the endurance of you gain the lives of you.

en.L: By your endurance gain your lives.
en.B: Hold out to the end, and so win your lives.
en.R: Do not give up! If you keep going, you will win true life.

es.L: Con {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} perseverancia {{plural_you:ganen|ganad}} {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} vidas.
es.B: {{plural_you:Resistan|Resistid}} hasta el fin, y así {{plural_you:ganen|ganad}} la vida.
es.R: ¡No {{plural_you:se den|os deis}} por vencidos! Si {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} adelante, {{plural_you:ganarán|ganaréis}} la vida verdadera.

fr.L: Par votre endurance, acquérez vos vies.
fr.B: Tenez bon jusqu’au bout : c’est ainsi que vous obtiendrez la vie.
fr.R: N’abandonnez pas ! Si vous tenez bon, vous recevrez la vraie vie.

sw.L: Kwa uvumilivu wenu jipatieni maisha yenu.
sw.B: Simameni imara mpaka mwisho, na hivyo mjipatie maisha yenu.
sw.R: Msikate tamaa! Mkiendelea kuvumilia, mtapata uzima wa kweli.

vi.L: Bằng sự kiên trì của các con, hãy giành lấy mạng sống các con.
vi.B: Hãy kiên trì đến cùng, và như vậy các con sẽ giữ được mạng sống mình.
vi.R: Đừng bỏ cuộc! Nếu các con cứ kiên trì, các con sẽ nhận được sự sống thật.

decisions.choice: gain: a command
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT prints the command. Other important manuscripts, among them Alexandrinus and Vaticanus, have the future, "you will gain". The two forms differ by one letter, and either way the point is that endurance leads to life. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: endurance: staying firm under pressure, not giving up
decisions.reason: The word is used of those who hold on to the word and bear fruit (8:15).

decisions.choice: lives: the true life of the person, life with God
alternatives: souls as a part of a person
decisions.reason: The same word is used where Jesus says that whoever loses his life for him will save it (9:24). Some will lose their lives in this world (21:16) but gain true life.

decisions.choice: Do not give up! If you keep going, you will win true life.
alternatives: By your endurance gain your lives.
decisions.reason: Readable turns the command into two short sentences and says what kind of life is meant, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: acquérez vos vies (L); vous obtiendrez la vie (B); vous recevrez la vraie vie (R)
decisions.reason: "Gagner sa vie" means to earn a living in French, so the English "win your lives" cannot be copied. "Vos âmes" would suggest the soul apart from the body; the meaning decision speaks of the true life of the person (m3). Literal keeps the command (m1).

decisions.choice: maisha yenu (L, B); uzima wa kweli (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the true life of the person, life with God (meaning decision m3). "Maisha" follows the term sheet for this word; "roho" is kept for the Holy Spirit and the human spirit. Readable says "uzima wa kweli", life itself, as the English Readable says "true life".

decisions.choice: "sự kiên trì" (L), "kiên trì" (B, R); "mạng sống" (L, B), "sự sống thật" (R)
decisions.reason: "mạng sống" for psyche, as in Luke 14:26; it means the true life of the person with God (meaning decision), which Readable says plainly.

source.text: Ὅταν δὲ ἴδητε κυκλουμένην ὑπὸ στρατοπέδων Ἰερουσαλήμ, τότε γνῶτε ὅτι ἤγγικεν ἡ ἐρήμωσις αὐτῆς.

records.literal_gloss: When then you see being surrounded by armies Jerusalem, then know that has drawn near the desolation of her.

en.L: But when you see Jerusalem being surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation has come near.
en.B: When you see Jerusalem with armies encamped all around it, then be sure that it will soon be laid waste.
en.R: Some day you will see armies all around Jerusalem. When that happens, you can be sure that the city will soon be destroyed.

es.L: Pero cuando {{plural_you:vean|veáis}} a Jerusalén siendo rodeada por ejércitos, entonces {{plural_you:sepan|sabed}} que se ha acercado su desolación.
es.B: Cuando {{plural_you:vean|veáis}} a Jerusalén con ejércitos acampados a su alrededor, {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} por seguro que pronto será arrasada.
es.R: Algún día {{plural_you:verán|veréis}} ejércitos alrededor de Jerusalén. Cuando eso pase, {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} estar seguros de que pronto la ciudad será destruida.

fr.L: Mais quand vous verrez Jérusalem encerclée par des armées, alors sachez que sa désolation s’est approchée.
fr.B: Quand vous verrez Jérusalem avec des armées campées tout autour, soyez sûrs qu’elle sera bientôt dévastée.
fr.R: Un jour, vous verrez des armées tout autour de Jérusalem. Quand cela arrivera, vous pourrez être sûrs que la ville sera bientôt détruite.

sw.L: Lakini mtakapoona Yerusalemu ikizungukwa na majeshi, ndipo jueni kwamba ukiwa wake umekaribia.
sw.B: Mtakapoona Yerusalemu imezungukwa na majeshi yaliyopiga kambi pande zote, basi jueni kwa hakika kwamba itaangamizwa hivi karibuni.
sw.R: Siku moja mtaona majeshi yakiizunguka Yerusalemu. Hilo likitokea, mnaweza kuwa na hakika kwamba mji huo utaangamizwa hivi karibuni.

vi.L: Nhưng khi các con thấy Giê-ru-sa-lem bị các đạo quân bao vây, thì hãy biết rằng sự hoang tàn của thành ấy đã gần.
vi.B: Khi các con thấy quân đội đóng trại vây quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem, thì hãy biết chắc rằng thành ấy sắp bị tàn phá.
vi.R: Một ngày kia các con sẽ thấy quân đội bao vây Giê-ru-sa-lem. Khi điều đó xảy ra, các con có thể biết chắc rằng thành ấy sắp bị hủy diệt.

decisions.choice: armies: armies in camp, encamped around the city
decisions.reason: The word means an army camp, and so an army in the field.

decisions.choice: its desolation: the city laid waste, as Daniel foretold
alternatives: the city emptied of people only
decisions.reason: The word echoes Daniel's prophecy of a desolation that would come on the city and the sanctuary (Daniel 9:26-27; compare Mark 13:14). Luke says plainly that it means the city's destruction.

decisions.choice: Jerusalem surrounded: fulfilled when Roman armies besieged and took the city in AD 70
alternatives: a siege at the end of history only
decisions.reason: Jesus had already spoken of enemies setting up a siege around the city (19:43). The siege of AD 70 is well known from history.

decisions.choice: know: a command: then be sure
decisions.reason: The form can be a command or a statement. After "then" it reads as a command.

source.text: τότε οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ φευγέτωσαν εἰς τὰ ὄρη, καὶ οἱ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς ἐκχωρείτωσαν, καὶ οἱ ἐν ταῖς χώραις μὴ εἰσερχέσθωσαν εἰς αὐτήν, ὅτι ἡμέραι ἐκδικήσεως αὗταί εἰσιν τοῦ πλησθῆναι πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα.

records.literal_gloss: Then those in the Judea let them flee to the mountains, and those in midst of her let them depart out, and those in the countrysides not let them enter into her, \v 22 because days of vengeance these are, of the to be fulfilled all things having been written.

en.L: Then those in Judea must flee to the mountains, and those inside the city must get out, and those in the country must not go into it, \v 22 because these are days of vengeance, for all the things that have been written to be fulfilled.
en.B: Then people in Judea should run for the hills. Those inside the city should leave it, and those out in the fields should not go back in. \v 22 For these are the days of punishment, when everything that is written will come true.
en.R: Then the people in Judea must run away to the mountains. People in the city must leave it. People out in the country must not go into the city. \v 22 At that time God will punish the city. Everything the Scriptures say will happen.

es.L: Entonces los que estén en Judea huyan a los montes, y los que estén dentro de la ciudad salgan, y los que estén en los campos no entren en ella, \v 22 porque estos son días de venganza, para que se cumpla todo lo que está escrito.
es.B: Entonces, los que estén en Judea, que huyan a los montes. Los que estén dentro de la ciudad, que salgan de ella, y los que estén en el campo, que no vuelvan a entrar. \v 22 Porque estos son los días del castigo, en que se cumplirá todo lo que está escrito.
es.R: Entonces la gente de Judea tiene que huir a las montañas. La gente de la ciudad tiene que salir de ella. La gente del campo no debe entrar en la ciudad. \v 22 En ese tiempo Dios castigará a la ciudad. Sucederá todo lo que dicen las Escrituras.

fr.L: Alors, que ceux qui sont en Judée fuient vers les montagnes, que ceux qui sont à l’intérieur de la ville en sortent, et que ceux qui sont dans les campagnes n’y entrent pas, \v 22 car ce sont là des jours de vengeance, pour que s’accomplisse tout ce qui est écrit.
fr.B: Alors, ceux qui seront en Judée devront s’enfuir vers les collines. Ceux qui seront dans la ville devront la quitter, et ceux qui seront dans les champs ne devront pas y rentrer. \v 22 Car ce seront les jours du châtiment, où tout ce qui est écrit s’accomplira.
fr.R: Alors, les gens qui sont en Judée devront s’enfuir dans les montagnes. Les gens qui sont dans la ville devront en sortir. Les gens qui sont à la campagne ne devront pas entrer dans la ville. \v 22 À ce moment-là, Dieu punira la ville. Tout ce que disent les Écritures arrivera.

sw.L: Hapo walioko Uyahudi na wakimbilie milimani, na walio ndani ya mji na watoke, na walio mashambani wasiingie ndani yake, \v 22 kwa sababu hizi ni siku za kisasi, ili yatimizwe yote yaliyoandikwa.
sw.B: Hapo watu walioko Uyahudi wakimbilie milimani. Walio ndani ya mji watoke, na walio mashambani wasirudi mjini. \v 22 Kwa maana hizi ni siku za adhabu, ambapo yote yaliyoandikwa yatatimia.
sw.R: Hapo watu walioko Uyahudi lazima wakimbilie milimani. Watu walio mjini lazima watoke. Watu walio mashambani wasiingie mjini. \v 22 Wakati huo Mungu atauadhibu mji huo. Yote ambayo Maandiko yanasema yatatokea.

vi.L: Bấy giờ những người ở Giu-đê phải trốn lên núi, những người ở trong thành phải ra khỏi, và những người ở ngoài đồng quê đừng vào thành, \v 22 vì đó là những ngày báo trả, để mọi điều đã chép được ứng nghiệm.
vi.B: Bấy giờ những ai đang ở Giu-đê hãy trốn lên vùng đồi núi. Ai ở trong thành hãy ra khỏi thành, và ai ở ngoài đồng đừng trở vào. \v 22 Vì đó là những ngày trừng phạt, khi mọi điều đã chép trong Kinh Thánh được ứng nghiệm.
vi.R: Khi ấy những người ở Giu-đê phải chạy trốn lên núi. Những người ở trong thành phải rời khỏi thành. Những người ở ngoài đồng không được vào thành. \v 22 Vào lúc đó, Đức Chúa Trời sẽ trừng phạt thành ấy. Mọi điều Kinh Thánh đã nói sẽ xảy ra.

decisions.choice: her: Jerusalem, not Judea
decisions.reason: Those in Judea are to flee to the hills, those in the city are to leave it, and those outside are not to go into it. The city is the one named in 21:20.

decisions.choice: vengeance: punishment, justice carried out
decisions.reason: The word is used of God's justice on the wicked. The prophets speak of days of punishment coming on Israel (Hosea 9:7; Deuteronomy 32:35).

decisions.choice: all that has been written: the prophets' warnings of judgment on Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The prophets had warned that the city and its temple would fall (Micah 3:12; Jeremiah 7:14; Daniel 9:26).

decisions.choice: inside the city (L, B); in the city (R)
decisions.reason: The pronoun refers to Jerusalem, and every level names the city.

decisions.choice: God will punish the city
decisions.reason: Readable names who punishes, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: "Giu-đê"; "ứng nghiệm" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The style guide's form for Judea; "ứng nghiệm" for fulfilment, as in Matthew.

decisions.choice: "báo trả" (L); "trừng phạt" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Vengeance here is just punishment (meaning decision).

source.text: οὐαὶ ταῖς ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσαις καὶ ταῖς θηλαζούσαις ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις· ἔσται γὰρ ἀνάγκη μεγάλη ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ὀργὴ τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ, καὶ πεσοῦνται στόματι μαχαίρης καὶ αἰχμαλωτισθήσονται εἰς τὰ ἔθνη πάντα, καὶ Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἔσται πατουμένη ὑπὸ ἐθνῶν, ἄχρι οὗ πληρωθῶσιν καιροὶ ἐθνῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Woe to the ones in womb having and to the ones nursing in those the days; will be for distress great upon the land and wrath to the people this, \v 24 and they will fall by mouth of sword and will be led captive into the nations all, and Jerusalem will be being trampled by Gentiles, until that are fulfilled times of Gentiles.

en.L: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who are nursing [babies] in those days! For there will be great distress upon the land and wrath against this people, \v 24 and they will fall by the edge of the sword and be led captive into all the nations, and Jerusalem will be trampled by [the] Gentiles until [the] times of [the] Gentiles are fulfilled.
en.B: How terrible it will be in those days for women who are pregnant or nursing a baby! Great hardship will come on the land, and wrath on this people. \v 24 They will be cut down by the sword and carried off as captives to every nation. Jerusalem will be trampled underfoot by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles have run their course.
en.R: How terrible it will be in those days for women who are going to have babies, and for mothers who are feeding babies! There will be great trouble in the land. God will be angry with this people and punish them. \v 24 Some will be killed with swords. Others will be taken away as prisoners to every nation. The Gentiles, people who are not Jews, will trample on Jerusalem until the time God has given them is over.

es.L: ¡Ay de las que tengan [un hijo] en el vientre y de las que amamanten en aquellos días! Porque habrá gran angustia sobre la tierra e ira contra este pueblo, \v 24 y caerán a filo de espada y serán llevados cautivos a todas las naciones, y Jerusalén será pisoteada por [los] gentiles hasta que se cumplan [los] tiempos de [los] gentiles.
es.B: ¡Ay de las mujeres que en aquellos días estén embarazadas o criando a un niño de pecho! Vendrá una gran angustia sobre esta tierra, y la ira sobre este pueblo. \v 24 Caerán a filo de espada y serán llevados cautivos a todas las naciones. Jerusalén será pisoteada por los gentiles hasta que los tiempos de los gentiles lleguen a su fin.
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será en aquellos días para las mujeres que van a tener un bebé y para las madres que dan el pecho a sus bebés! Habrá grandes problemas en el país. Dios se enojará con este pueblo y lo castigará. \v 24 A algunos los matarán con espadas. A otros se los llevarán presos a todas las naciones. Los gentiles, la gente que no es judía, pisotearán Jerusalén hasta que termine el tiempo que Dios les ha dado.

fr.L: Malheur à celles qui sont enceintes et à celles qui allaitent en ces jours-là ! Car il y aura une grande détresse sur le pays, et une colère contre ce peuple, \v 24 et ils tomberont sous le tranchant de l’épée, et seront emmenés captifs dans toutes les nations, et Jérusalem sera foulée aux pieds par les nations jusqu’à ce que soient accomplis les temps des nations.
fr.B: Comme ce sera terrible, en ces jours-là, pour les femmes enceintes et pour celles qui allaitent ! Une grande détresse s’abattra sur le pays, et la colère sur ce peuple. \v 24 Ils tomberont sous l’épée et seront emmenés captifs chez toutes les nations. Jérusalem sera piétinée par les non-Juifs jusqu’à ce que les temps des non-Juifs soient achevés.
fr.R: Comme ce sera terrible, en ces jours-là, pour les femmes qui attendent un bébé, et pour les mamans qui nourrissent leur bébé ! Il y aura de grands malheurs dans le pays. Dieu sera en colère contre ce peuple et le punira. \v 24 Certains seront tués à l’épée. D’autres seront emmenés comme prisonniers dans tous les pays. Les peuples qui ne sont pas juifs piétineront Jérusalem jusqu’à ce que le temps que Dieu leur a donné soit fini.

sw.L: Ole wao wenye [watoto] tumboni na wale wanaonyonyesha katika siku hizo! Kwa maana kutakuwa na dhiki kubwa juu ya nchi na ghadhabu kwa watu hawa, \v 24 nao wataanguka kwa makali ya upanga na kuchukuliwa mateka kwenda mataifa yote, na Yerusalemu itakanyagwa na watu wa mataifa hadi nyakati za watu wa mataifa zitakapotimia.
sw.B: Ole wao wanawake wenye mimba na wale wanaonyonyesha watoto katika siku hizo! Taabu kubwa itaikumba nchi hii, na ghadhabu itawajia watu hawa. \v 24 Watauawa kwa upanga na kuchukuliwa mateka kwenda katika mataifa yote. Yerusalemu itakanyagwa na watu wa mataifa mpaka nyakati za watu wa mataifa zitakapomalizika.
sw.R: Itakuwa vibaya sana siku hizo kwa wanawake wajawazito na kwa mama wanaonyonyesha watoto wao! Kutakuwa na taabu kubwa nchini. Mungu atawakasirikia watu hawa na kuwaadhibu. \v 24 Baadhi yao watauawa kwa upanga. Wengine watachukuliwa kama wafungwa kwenda katika kila taifa. Watu wa mataifa, yaani watu wasio Wayahudi, wataikanyaga Yerusalemu hadi wakati ambao Mungu amewapa utakapokwisha.

vi.L: Khốn cho những người đang mang thai và những người đang cho con bú trong những ngày ấy! Vì sẽ có hoạn nạn lớn trên xứ và cơn thịnh nộ trên dân này; \v 24 họ sẽ ngã dưới lưỡi gươm, và bị bắt làm phu tù đến khắp các dân tộc, và Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ bị các dân ngoại giày đạp cho đến khi các thời kỳ của các dân ngoại được trọn.
vi.B: Trong những ngày ấy, thật khốn khổ cho những phụ nữ đang mang thai hoặc đang cho con bú! Vì sẽ có tai họa lớn trên xứ này, và cơn thịnh nộ giáng trên dân này. \v 24 Họ sẽ ngã chết dưới lưỡi gươm và bị bắt làm phu tù đến mọi dân tộc. Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ bị các dân ngoại giày đạp cho đến khi thời kỳ của các dân ngoại kết thúc.
vi.R: Những ngày ấy sẽ rất khổ cho những phụ nữ sắp sinh con và những người mẹ đang cho con bú! Sẽ có tai họa lớn trong xứ. Đức Chúa Trời sẽ nổi giận với dân này và trừng phạt họ. \v 24 Một số người sẽ bị giết bằng gươm. Những người khác sẽ bị bắt đem đi làm tù binh ở khắp các nước.
