Các dân ngoại, là những người không phải người Do Thái, sẽ giày đạp Giê-ru-sa-lem cho đến khi hết thời gian Đức Chúa Trời đã định cho họ.

decisions.choice: the land: the land of Israel
decisions.reason: The same word means land or earth. Here the subject is Judea and Jerusalem (21:20-21).

decisions.choice: wrath: God's anger against sin, shown in judgment
decisions.reason: John the Baptist warned of the wrath to come (3:7). Here it falls on "this people", the people of the city that rejected its king (19:41-44).

decisions.choice: mouth of the sword: the edge of the sword
decisions.reason: A Hebrew way of speaking of the sword's edge as its mouth (Genesis 34:26).

decisions.choice: the times of the Gentiles: a limited time, set by God, in which the Gentiles rule over Jerusalem
alternatives: the time for the gospel to go to the Gentiles
the time of the Gentiles' own judgment
decisions.reason: The phrase says that Gentile rule over the city has an end that God has fixed. Whether it also means the time in which the good news goes out to the nations (24:47) is debated.

decisions.choice: Woe to (L); How terrible it will be for (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 6:24-26 and 11:42-52: Literal keeps the old word, and Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: people who are not Jews; the time God has given them
decisions.reason: Readable explains the word Gentiles and the phrase, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: ¡Ay de...! (L, B)
alternatives: ¡Qué terrible será...! (B), as the English Balanced
decisions.reason: The cry of grief and pity is "¡ay!" at Literal and Balanced across the New Testament drafts, as in Mark 13:17; Spanish still uses it in this sense. Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Malheur à (L); Comme ce sera terrible pour (B, R)
alternatives: Malheur à (B), as the term sheet's "Malheur à vous"
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "Malheur à vous" at Balanced for Jesus' woes spoken to people; here the word is a lament over what the women will suffer, and Balanced follows the English "How terrible it will be", as Mark 13:17 does.

decisions.choice: les nations (L); les non-Juifs (B); les peuples qui ne sont pas juifs (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's forms for the Gentiles; "toutes les nations" stays "nations" ("pays" at R) where peoples and lands are meant. Readable says "les peuples qui ne sont pas juifs" as its explanation of the word (r-en-2).

decisions.choice: Ole wao (L, B)
alternatives: Itakuwa vibaya sana (B), as the English Balanced
decisions.reason: The cry of grief and pity is "ole" at Literal and Balanced across the New Testament drafts, as in Mark 13:17. Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Khốn cho" (L); "thật khốn khổ cho" (B); "sẽ rất khổ cho" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Luke 6:24-26 and Mark 13:17.

decisions.choice: "các dân ngoại" at every level; Readable explains it
decisions.reason: The word used for the Gentiles through Luke (2:32).

source.text: Καὶ ἔσονται σημεῖα ἐν ἡλίῳ καὶ σελήνῃ καὶ ἄστροις, καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς συνοχὴ ἐθνῶν ἐν ἀπορίᾳ ἤχους θαλάσσης καὶ σάλου, ἀποψυχόντων ἀνθρώπων ἀπὸ φόβου καὶ προσδοκίας τῶν ἐπερχομένων τῇ οἰκουμένῃ, αἱ γὰρ δυνάμεις τῶν οὐρανῶν σαλευθήσονται.

records.literal_gloss: And there will be signs in sun and moon and stars, and upon the earth distress of nations in perplexity at roaring of sea and surge, \v 26 fainting of men from fear and expectation of the things coming upon the inhabited world, the for powers of the heavens will be shaken.

en.L: And there will be signs in sun and moon and stars, and on the earth distress of nations, in perplexity at the roar of [the] sea and [its] surge, \v 26 people fainting from fear and expectation of the things coming upon the inhabited world; for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
en.B: Signs will appear in the sun, the moon and the stars. On the earth whole nations will be gripped with distress, not knowing where to turn as the sea roars and heaves. \v 26 Fear will drain the strength out of people as they wait for what is coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
en.R: Strange things will happen to the sun, the moon, and the stars. These will be signs. On earth, the nations will be in great trouble. They will be confused and afraid because the sea roars and its waves crash. \v 26 People will be so afraid that they will feel faint. They will wait in fear for what is going to happen to the world. This is because the powers in the sky will be shaken.

es.L: Y habrá señales en sol y luna y estrellas, y sobre la tierra angustia de naciones, perplejas ante el estruendo del mar y del oleaje, \v 26 desfalleciendo la gente de miedo y de expectación de las cosas que vienen sobre el mundo habitado; porque los poderes de los cielos serán sacudidos.
es.B: Habrá señales en el sol, la luna y las estrellas. En la tierra, las naciones estarán angustiadas, sin saber qué hacer ante el bramido del mar y de las olas. \v 26 La gente se quedará sin fuerzas por el miedo, mientras espera lo que va a venir sobre el mundo, porque los poderes de los cielos serán sacudidos.
es.R: Pasarán cosas extrañas con el sol, la luna y las estrellas. Serán señales. En la tierra, las naciones estarán en grandes problemas. Estarán confundidas y asustadas porque el mar ruge y sus olas golpean con fuerza. \v 26 La gente tendrá tanto miedo que se sentirá desfallecer. Esperarán con miedo lo que le va a pasar al mundo. Esto será porque los poderes del cielo serán sacudidos.

fr.L: Et il y aura des signes dans le soleil et la lune et les étoiles, et sur la terre l’angoisse des nations, dans le désarroi devant le grondement de la mer et des flots, \v 26 des {{gender:humains|hommes}} défaillant de peur et dans l’attente de ce qui va arriver sur le monde habité ; car les puissances des cieux seront ébranlées.
fr.B: Des signes apparaîtront dans le soleil, la lune et les étoiles. Sur la terre, les nations seront saisies d’angoisse, ne sachant que faire devant la mer qui gronde et se soulève. \v 26 La peur ôtera aux gens toutes leurs forces, dans l’attente de ce qui va s’abattre sur le monde, car les puissances des cieux seront ébranlées.
fr.R: Des choses étranges arriveront au soleil, à la lune et aux étoiles. Ce seront des signes. Sur la terre, les nations seront dans une grande détresse. Elles ne sauront plus que faire et elles auront peur, parce que la mer grondera et que ses vagues se fracasseront. \v 26 Les gens auront tellement peur qu’ils seront près de s’évanouir. Ils attendront avec crainte ce qui va arriver au monde. Car les puissances du ciel seront secouées.

sw.L: Na kutakuwa na ishara katika jua na mwezi na nyota, na juu ya nchi dhiki ya mataifa, katika kuchanganyikiwa kwa ajili ya mvumo wa bahari na mawimbi [yake], \v 26 watu wakizimia kwa hofu na kwa kutazamia mambo yanayoujia ulimwengu; kwa maana nguvu za mbinguni zitatikiswa.
sw.B: Kutakuwa na ishara katika jua, mwezi na nyota. Duniani mataifa yatakuwa katika dhiki, yasijue la kufanya, bahari inapovuma na kuchafuka. \v 26 Watu watakosa nguvu kwa hofu wanaposubiri yale yanayoujia ulimwengu, kwa maana nguvu za mbinguni zitatikiswa.
sw.R: Mambo ya ajabu yatatokea kwa jua, mwezi na nyota. Hayo yatakuwa ishara. Duniani mataifa yatakuwa katika taabu kubwa. Yatachanganyikiwa na kuogopa kwa sababu bahari itanguruma na mawimbi yake kupiga kwa nguvu. \v 26 Watu wataogopa sana hata wahisi kuzimia. Watasubiri kwa hofu yale yatakayoupata ulimwengu. Hii ni kwa sababu nguvu zilizoko angani zitatikiswa.

vi.L: Và sẽ có những dấu hiệu nơi mặt trời, mặt trăng và các ngôi sao; còn trên đất, các dân tộc sẽ khốn đốn, bối rối vì tiếng biển gầm và sóng dậy, \v 26 người ta sẽ ngất xỉu vì sợ hãi và vì chờ đợi những điều sắp xảy đến cho thế gian; vì các quyền lực trên các tầng trời sẽ bị rúng động.
vi.B: Sẽ có những dấu hiệu nơi mặt trời, mặt trăng và các ngôi sao. Trên đất, các dân tộc sẽ khốn đốn, không biết phải làm sao trước tiếng biển gầm thét và sóng cuồn cuộn. \v 26 Người ta sẽ mất hết sức lực vì sợ hãi khi chờ đợi những gì sắp xảy đến cho thế gian, vì các quyền lực trên các tầng trời sẽ bị rúng động.
vi.R: Sẽ có những điều lạ xảy ra với mặt trời, mặt trăng và các ngôi sao. Đó sẽ là những dấu hiệu. Trên đất, các dân tộc sẽ gặp khốn khổ lớn. Họ sẽ bối rối và sợ hãi vì biển gầm thét và sóng vỗ dữ dội. \v 26 Người ta sẽ sợ đến mức muốn ngất xỉu. Họ sẽ run sợ chờ xem điều gì sắp xảy ra cho thế gian. Đó là vì các quyền lực trên bầu trời sẽ bị rúng động.

decisions.choice: signs in sun, moon and stars: the prophets' pictures of the day of the Lord
decisions.reason: The prophets speak of the sun and moon going dark and the stars falling when God comes to judge (Isaiah 13:10; 34:4; Ezekiel 32:7).

decisions.choice: fainting: losing heart and strength, as if the life were going out of them
decisions.reason: The word can mean to faint or even to die. Here it describes people overcome with fear.

decisions.choice: the powers of the heavens: the sun, moon and stars, the heavenly bodies
decisions.reason: In Isaiah 34:4 the host of heaven melts away. Some take the powers to be spiritual beings, but the verse continues the signs in the sky of 21:25.

decisions.choice: the inhabited world: the whole world where people live
decisions.reason: The word means the inhabited earth (2:1; 4:5).

decisions.choice: Strange things will happen to the sun, the moon, and the stars. These will be signs.
alternatives: There will be signs in sun and moon and stars.
decisions.reason: Readable says first what will happen and then names it a sign.

decisions.choice: des {{gender:humains|hommes}} (L); les gens (B, R)
decisions.reason: English Literal says "people" with no setting; French Literal renders the noun for human beings and must choose between "humains" and "hommes", so it carries the gender setting. Balanced and Readable say "les gens", which is already inclusive.

decisions.choice: "các quyền lực trên các tầng trời" (L, B); "trên bầu trời" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 13:25; the heavenly bodies are meant (meaning decision), so Readable says "the sky".

source.text: καὶ τότε ὄψονται τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐν νεφέλῃ μετὰ δυνάμεως καὶ δόξης πολλῆς.

records.literal_gloss: And then they will see the Son of the Man coming in a cloud with power and glory great.

en.L: And then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
en.B: And then people will see the Son of Man come in a cloud with power and with great glory.
en.R: Then people will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud. He will come with power and great glory.

es.L: Y entonces verán al Hijo del Hombre viniendo en una nube con poder y gran gloria.
es.B: Y entonces la gente verá al Hijo del Hombre venir en una nube, con poder y con gran gloria.
es.R: Entonces la gente verá al Hijo del Hombre venir en una nube. Vendrá con poder y gran gloria.

fr.L: Et alors ils verront le Fils de l’homme venant dans une nuée avec puissance et une grande gloire.
fr.B: Alors les gens verront le Fils de l’homme venir dans une nuée, avec puissance et une grande gloire.
fr.R: Alors les gens verront le Fils de l’homme arriver dans un nuage. Il viendra avec puissance et une grande gloire.

sw.L: Na hapo watamwona Mwana wa Adamu akija katika wingu pamoja na nguvu na utukufu mwingi.
sw.B: Ndipo watu watakapomwona Mwana wa Adamu akija katika wingu, akiwa na nguvu na utukufu mkuu.
sw.R: Kisha watu watamwona Mwana wa Adamu akija katika wingu. Atakuja akiwa na nguvu na utukufu mkuu.

vi.L: Và bấy giờ người ta sẽ thấy Con Người đến trong một đám mây với quyền năng và vinh quang lớn.
vi.B: Bấy giờ người ta sẽ thấy Con Người đến trong đám mây, với quyền năng và vinh quang lớn.
vi.R: Bấy giờ mọi người sẽ thấy Con Người đến trong đám mây. Con Người sẽ đến với quyền năng và vinh quang lớn.

decisions.choice: the Son of Man coming in a cloud: Daniel 7:13-14
alternatives: a new picture without a source
decisions.reason: Daniel saw one like a son of man come with the clouds of heaven and receive authority, glory and a kingdom. Jesus speaks of himself (9:26).

decisions.choice: a cloud: the sign of God's presence
decisions.reason: God's presence went with Israel in a cloud (Exodus 13:21), and a cloud covered the disciples on the mountain (9:34-35). Jesus was taken up in a cloud and will come back in the same way (Acts 1:9-11).

decisions.choice: they: the people of the earth just described
decisions.reason: The verb has no stated subject. It continues from the nations and people of 21:25-26.

decisions.choice: people will see
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name who will see, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: el Hijo del Hombre
decisions.reason: The title used across the New Testament drafts. "Hombre" here means humankind, as in Daniel 7:13 (meaning decision m1), and the title is never under the gender setting.

decisions.choice: Mwana wa Adamu
decisions.reason: The title used across the New Testament drafts, as in John: "Adamu" also means humankind (meaning decision m1, Daniel 7:13). "Mwana wa Mtu" is closer to the Greek words; a reviewer should weigh it.

decisions.choice: "Con Người" as the subject (R), where the English has "He"
decisions.reason: As in Mark 13:26-27: Vietnamese repeats the title rather than use a pronoun for the Son of Man in Jesus' own words.

source.text: ἀρχομένων δὲ τούτων γίνεσθαι ἀνακύψατε καὶ ἐπάρατε τὰς κεφαλὰς ὑμῶν, διότι ἐγγίζει ἡ ἀπολύτρωσις ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Beginning then these things to take place, straighten up and lift up the heads of you, because draws near the redemption of you.

en.L: And when these things begin to take place, stand up straight and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near."
en.B: As soon as these things start to happen, straighten up and look up, for the day of your redemption is almost here."
en.R: When these things start to happen, stand up straight and look up! God is coming soon to set you free."

es.L: Y cuando estas cosas comiencen a suceder, {{plural_you:enderécense|enderezaos}} y {{plural_you:levanten|levantad}} {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} cabezas, porque {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} redención se acerca».
es.B: En cuanto estas cosas empiecen a suceder, {{plural_you:enderécense|enderezaos}} y {{plural_you:levanten|levantad}} la mirada, porque el día de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} redención está ya muy cerca».
es.R: Cuando estas cosas empiecen a pasar, ¡{{plural_you:pónganse|poneos}} de pie y {{plural_you:levanten|levantad}} la mirada! Dios viene pronto a {{plural_you:liberarlos|liberaros}}».

fr.L: Et quand ces choses commenceront à arriver, redressez-vous et levez vos têtes, parce que votre rédemption approche. »
fr.B: Dès que cela commencera à arriver, redressez-vous et levez les yeux, car le jour de votre rédemption est tout proche. »
fr.R: Quand ces choses commenceront à arriver, redressez-vous et levez les yeux ! Dieu va bientôt venir vous libérer. »

sw.L: Na mambo haya yatakapoanza kutokea, simameni wima na kuinua vichwa vyenu, kwa sababu ukombozi wenu unakaribia."
sw.B: Mambo haya yatakapoanza tu kutokea, simameni wima na kutazama juu, kwa maana siku ya ukombozi wenu imekaribia sana."
sw.R: Mambo haya yatakapoanza kutokea, simameni wima na kutazama juu! Mungu anakuja hivi karibuni kuwaweka huru."

vi.L: Và khi những điều này bắt đầu xảy ra, hãy đứng thẳng lên và ngẩng đầu lên, vì sự cứu chuộc của các con đang đến gần."
vi.B: Khi những điều ấy bắt đầu xảy ra, hãy đứng thẳng lên và ngước mặt lên, vì ngày các con được cứu chuộc đã gần kề."
vi.R: Khi những điều này bắt đầu xảy ra, hãy đứng thẳng lên và ngước nhìn lên! Đức Chúa Trời sắp đến để giải cứu các con."

decisions.choice: redemption: release, being set free by God
decisions.reason: The word comes from the setting free of slaves and captives. Zechariah and Anna spoke of God redeeming his people (1:68; 2:38).

decisions.choice: straighten up and lift your heads: take courage, look up with hope
decisions.reason: People bowed down with fear or shame keep their heads low. The disciples are to look up, because the signs that terrify others mean rescue for them.

decisions.choice: God is coming soon to set you free
decisions.reason: Readable says what redemption is and who brings it, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: the quotation closes here
alternatives: a separate quotation for each sentence
decisions.reason: The speech begun in 21:10 ends, and Luke's narration starts again in 21:29.

decisions.choice: "sự cứu chuộc" (L), "được cứu chuộc" (B); "giải cứu" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Luke 2:38; Readable says it plainly, as the English does.

source.text: Καὶ εἶπεν παραβολὴν αὐτοῖς· Ἴδετε τὴν συκῆν καὶ πάντα τὰ δένδρα·

records.literal_gloss: And he said a parable to them, Look at the fig tree and all the trees;

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told them a parable: "Look at the fig tree and all the trees.
en.B: He told them a parable: "Look at the fig tree, and at all the trees.
en.R: Then Jesus told them a parable, a story with a lesson: "Look at the fig tree and at all the other trees.

es.L: Y les dijo una parábola: «{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}} la higuera y todos los árboles.
es.B: Les contó una parábola: «{{plural_you:Fíjense|Fijaos}} en la higuera y en todos los árboles.
es.R: Entonces Jesús les contó una parábola, una historia con una enseñanza: «{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}} la higuera y todos los demás árboles.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit une parabole : « Regardez le figuier et tous les arbres.
fr.B: Il leur raconta une parabole : « Regardez le figuier, et tous les arbres.
fr.R: Puis Jésus leur a raconté une parabole, une histoire qui donne une leçon : « Regardez le figuier et tous les autres arbres.

sw.L: Akawaambia mfano: "Utazameni mtini na miti yote.
sw.B: Akawapa mfano: "Utazameni mtini, na miti yote.
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akawaambia mfano, hadithi yenye funzo: "Utazameni mtini na miti mingine yote.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} kể cho họ một ngụ ngôn: "Hãy xem cây vả và mọi cây cối.
vi.B: Ngài kể cho họ một ngụ ngôn: "Hãy xem cây vả và mọi cây khác.
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu kể cho họ một câu chuyện để dạy họ: "Hãy nhìn cây vả và tất cả những cây khác.

decisions.choice: parable: a comparison taken from everyday life
decisions.reason: A parable can be a short comparison, as here, or a story (8:4).

decisions.choice: the fig tree: a tree that loses its leaves in winter and puts out new leaves late in spring
decisions.reason: Fig trees were common in the land. Their new leaves showed that summer was near (Song of Songs 2:13).

decisions.choice: a story with a lesson
decisions.reason: Readable explains the word, as in 8:4.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and runs on to 21:36
alternatives: a separate quotation for each sentence
decisions.reason: Jesus' words in 21:29-36 are one speech.

decisions.choice: "ngụ ngôn" (L, B); "câu chuyện để dạy họ" (R); "cây vả" for the fig tree
decisions.reason: As in Luke 13:6.

source.text: ὅταν προβάλωσιν ἤδη, βλέποντες ἀφ’ ἑαυτῶν γινώσκετε ὅτι ἤδη ἐγγὺς τὸ θέρος ἐστίν·

records.literal_gloss: When they put out already, seeing from yourselves you know that already near the summer is;

en.L: When they already put out [leaves], you see [it] and know for yourselves that summer is already near.
en.B: Once they burst into leaf, you only need to look at them to know that summer is near.
en.R: When they start to grow new leaves, you see them, and you know that summer will soon be here.

es.L: Cuando ya echan [hojas], al verlo {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} por {{plural_you:ustedes mismos|vosotros mismos}} que ya está cerca el verano.
es.B: En cuanto echan hojas, basta con mirarlos para saber que el verano está cerca.
es.R: Cuando les empiezan a salir hojas nuevas, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} las {{plural_you:ven|veis}} y {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que pronto llegará el verano.

fr.L: Quand déjà ils bourgeonnent, vous [le] voyez et vous savez par vous-mêmes que l’été est déjà proche.
fr.B: Dès qu’ils se couvrent de feuilles, il vous suffit de les regarder pour savoir que l’été est proche.
fr.R: Quand de nouvelles feuilles commencent à pousser, vous les voyez, et vous savez que l’été arrivera bientôt.

sw.L: Inapokwisha kuchipua [majani], mkiona mnajua wenyewe kwamba kiangazi kiko karibu sasa.
sw.B: Inapoanza kuchipua majani, mnaitazama tu, nanyi mnajua kwamba kiangazi kimekaribia.
sw.R: Inapoanza kutoa majani mapya, mnaiona, na mnajua kwamba kiangazi kitafika hivi karibuni.

vi.L: Khi chúng đã nảy [lá], các con thấy và tự mình biết rằng mùa hè đã gần.
vi.B: Khi chúng vừa trổ lá, các con chỉ cần nhìn là tự biết mùa hè đã gần.
vi.R: Khi cây bắt đầu ra lá non, các con nhìn thấy và biết rằng mùa hè sắp đến.

decisions.choice: for yourselves: without anyone telling you
decisions.reason: Anyone can read the season from the trees. In the same way the disciples will read the signs (21:31).

decisions.choice: [leaves] (L); leaf, leaves (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to put out shoots or leaves. English needs to say what the trees put out.

decisions.choice: ils bourgeonnent (L), with no supplied noun
decisions.reason: English Literal has to supply [leaves]; the French verb "bourgeonner" says by itself that the trees put out shoots, so Literal needs no bracket there.

decisions.choice: kiangazi (the hot, dry season)
decisions.reason: In the land of Israel summer is the hot, dry season after the rains, when the fig tree is in full leaf. "Kiangazi" is that season in East Africa, as in Mark 13:28.

source.text: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς, ὅταν ἴδητε ταῦτα γινόμενα, γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγύς ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: So also you, when you see these things taking place, know that near is the kingdom of the God.

en.L: So also you, when you see these things taking place, know that the kingdom of God is near.
en.B: It is the same with you. When you see these things happening, be sure of this: the kingdom of God is near.
en.R: It is the same for you. When you see these things happen, you will know that the kingdom of God is coming soon.

es.L: Así también {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, cuando {{plural_you:vean|veáis}} que suceden estas cosas, {{plural_you:sepan|sabed}} que está cerca el reino de Dios.
es.B: Lo mismo {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: cuando {{plural_you:vean|veáis}} que estas cosas suceden, {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} por seguro que el reino de Dios está cerca.
es.R: Lo mismo pasa con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Cuando {{plural_you:vean|veáis}} que pasan estas cosas, {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que el reino de Dios llegará pronto.

fr.L: Ainsi vous aussi, quand vous verrez ces choses arriver, sachez que le royaume de Dieu est proche.
fr.B: De même pour vous : quand vous verrez cela arriver, soyez-en sûrs, le royaume de Dieu est proche.
fr.R: C’est la même chose pour vous. Quand vous verrez ces choses arriver, vous saurez que le royaume de Dieu va bientôt venir.

sw.L: Vivyo hivyo nanyi, mtakapoona mambo haya yakitokea, jueni kwamba ufalme wa Mungu u karibu.
sw.B: Ndivyo ilivyo kwenu pia. Mtakapoona mambo haya yakitokea, jueni kwa hakika kwamba ufalme wa Mungu umekaribia.
sw.R: Ndivyo ilivyo kwenu. Mtakapoona mambo haya yakitokea, mtajua kwamba ufalme wa Mungu unakuja hivi karibuni.

vi.L: Cũng vậy, các con, khi thấy những điều này xảy ra, hãy biết rằng vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời đã gần.
vi.B: Các con cũng vậy: khi thấy những điều này xảy ra, hãy biết chắc rằng vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời đã gần.
vi.R: Các con cũng vậy. Khi các con thấy những điều này xảy ra, các con sẽ biết rằng vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời sắp đến.

decisions.choice: know: a command or a statement; both say the same
decisions.reason: The form can be read either way. The disciples are to recognize what the signs mean.

decisions.choice: the kingdom of God is near: God's rule is about to come in its fullness
alternatives: the kingdom has not yet begun at all
decisions.reason: The kingdom was already present in Jesus (17:21). Here it is the kingdom coming in full with the Son of Man (21:27-28).

decisions.choice: these things: the signs Jesus has described
decisions.reason: The comparison applies the lesson of the trees to the signs of 21:25-28.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:sepan|sabed}} (L); {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} por seguro (B): a command; {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek form can be a command or a statement, and both say the same (meaning decision m1). Spanish must pick one form; Literal and Balanced take the command, as the English "know" and "be sure", and Readable the future, as the English "you will know".

source.text: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη ἕως ἂν πάντα γένηται.

records.literal_gloss: Truly I say to you that not not will pass away the generation this until all things take place.

en.L: Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all [these things] take place.
en.B: Truly I tell you, all of this will happen before this generation is gone.
en.R: I tell you the truth, the people of this generation will not all die before all these things happen.

es.L: En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que de ningún modo pasará esta generación hasta que todo [esto] suceda.
es.B: En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que todo esto sucederá antes de que esta generación desaparezca.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: la gente de esta generación no habrá muerto toda antes de que pasen todas estas cosas.

fr.L: En vérité, je vous le dis : cette génération ne passera certainement pas avant que tout [cela] soit arrivé.
fr.B: En vérité, je vous le dis : tout cela arrivera avant que cette génération ait disparu.
fr.R: Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité : les gens de cette génération ne mourront pas tous avant que toutes ces choses arrivent.

sw.L: Kweli nawaambia kwamba kizazi hiki hakitapita kamwe hadi [mambo] yote yatokee.
sw.B: Kweli nawaambia, mambo haya yote yatatokea kabla kizazi hiki hakijatoweka.
sw.R: Nawaambia ukweli: watu wa kizazi hiki hawatakufa wote kabla mambo haya yote hayajatokea.

vi.L: Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con rằng thế hệ này chắc chắn sẽ không qua đi cho đến khi mọi điều xảy ra.
vi.B: Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, tất cả những điều này sẽ xảy ra trước khi thế hệ này qua đi.
vi.R: Ta nói thật với các con: những người thuộc thế hệ này sẽ không chết hết trước khi tất cả những điều này xảy ra.

decisions.choice: Truly: a Hebrew word (amen) that confirms what follows
decisions.reason: Jesus uses amen to introduce his own words with authority, as in 4:24.

decisions.choice: this generation: the people living in Jesus' day
alternatives: the Jewish people through the ages
the generation that sees the final signs
decisions.reason: In Luke "this generation" means Jesus' own contemporaries (7:31; 11:29-32, 50-51; 17:25). On this reading "all" includes what the disciples asked about, the fall of the temple (21:6-7), which came within forty years. Others take the phrase in one of the wider senses, because the coming of the Son of Man is still awaited.

decisions.choice: certainly not: a strong double negative
decisions.reason: The Greek uses two negatives together for an emphatic denial.

decisions.choice: Truly I tell you (L, B); I tell you the truth (R)
decisions.reason: Luke's usual rendering, as in 4:24.

decisions.choice: all of this will happen before this generation is gone
alternatives: this generation will not pass away until all takes place
decisions.reason: Balanced turns the double negative into a plain statement with the same meaning.

decisions.choice: En verdad les digo (L, B); Les digo la verdad (R), as also in 21:3
decisions.reason: The wording used for Jesus's single "amen" across the New Testament drafts (meaning decision m1). "De cierto" is older church Spanish.

decisions.choice: "thế hệ này" at every level
decisions.reason: As in Mark 13:30 and Luke 7:31.

source.text: ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ παρελεύσονται, οἱ δὲ λόγοι μου οὐ μὴ παρελεύσονται.

records.literal_gloss: The heaven and the earth will pass away, the but words of me not not will pass away.

en.L: Heaven and earth will pass away, but {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words will certainly not pass away.
en.B: Heaven and earth will disappear, but {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words will last forever.
en.R: The sky and the earth will not last forever. But what I say will last forever.

es.L: El cielo y la tierra pasarán, pero {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras de ningún modo pasarán.
es.B: El cielo y la tierra desaparecerán, pero {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras permanecerán para siempre.
es.R: El cielo y la tierra no durarán para siempre. Pero lo que yo digo durará para siempre.

fr.L: Le ciel et la terre passeront, mais {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles ne passeront certainement pas.
fr.B: Le ciel et la terre disparaîtront, mais {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles dureront toujours.
fr.R: Le ciel et la terre ne dureront pas toujours. Mais ce que je dis durera toujours.

sw.L: Mbingu na nchi zitapita, lakini maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} hayatapita kamwe.
sw.B: Mbingu na dunia zitatoweka, lakini maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} yatadumu milele.
sw.R: Anga na dunia havitadumu milele. Lakini yale ninayosema yatadumu milele.

vi.L: Trời và đất sẽ qua đi, nhưng các lời của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chắc chắn sẽ không qua đi.
vi.B: Trời đất sẽ qua đi, nhưng lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không bao giờ qua đi.
vi.R: Trời và đất sẽ không còn mãi. Nhưng những gì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói sẽ còn mãi mãi.

decisions.choice: my words will not pass away: Jesus' words last as God's own word does
alternatives: his words will be remembered by people
decisions.reason: The prophets say that the word of God stands forever while all else fades (Isaiah 40:8; 51:6). Jesus says the same of his own words.

decisions.choice: heaven and earth: the whole created world
alternatives: the place of God and the place of people
decisions.reason: The pair names everything God made (Genesis 1:1).

decisions.choice: certainly not: a strong double negative
decisions.reason: The Greek uses two negatives together for an emphatic denial.

decisions.choice: will last forever
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say the strong negative in a positive way.

decisions.choice: what I say
decisions.reason: Readable uses an everyday phrase.

source.text: Προσέχετε δὲ ἑαυτοῖς μήποτε βαρηθῶσιν ὑμῶν αἱ καρδίαι ἐν κραιπάλῃ καὶ μέθῃ καὶ μερίμναις βιωτικαῖς, καὶ ἐπιστῇ ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς αἰφνίδιος ἡ ἡμέρα ἐκείνη ὡς παγίς· ἐπεισελεύσεται γὰρ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς καθημένους ἐπὶ πρόσωπον πάσης τῆς γῆς.

records.literal_gloss: Take heed then to yourselves lest be weighed down of you the hearts with carousing and drunkenness and cares of life, and come upon you suddenly the day that \v 35 as a trap; it will come in for upon all those sitting upon face of all the earth.

en.L: But watch yourselves, so that your hearts are not weighed down with carousing and drunkenness and the cares of life, and that day comes upon you suddenly \v 35 like a trap; for it will come upon all who live on the face of the whole earth.
en.B: Be on your guard. Do not let your hearts grow dull with wild parties and drinking and the worries of everyday life, or that day will catch you off guard, \v 35 like a trap that snaps shut. It will come on everyone who lives anywhere on earth.
en.R: Be careful! Do not let wild parties, drinking too much, or worrying about this life fill up your thoughts. If you do, that day will come on you when you do not expect it, \v 35 like a trap that catches an animal. That day will come to everyone who lives on the earth.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:estén atentos a ustedes mismos|estad atentos a vosotros mismos}}, no sea que {{plural_you:sus corazones|vuestros corazones}} se vean cargados de juergas y borracheras y preocupaciones de la vida, y aquel día venga sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} de repente \v 35 como una trampa; porque vendrá sobre todos los que habitan sobre la faz de toda la tierra.
es.B: {{plural_you:Estén|Estad}} en guardia. No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}} se embote con fiestas desenfrenadas, borracheras y las preocupaciones de la vida diaria; de lo contrario, aquel día {{plural_you:los|os}} tomará desprevenidos, \v 35 como una trampa que se cierra de golpe. Vendrá sobre todos los que viven en cualquier lugar de la tierra.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado! No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que las fiestas desenfrenadas, el beber demasiado o las preocupaciones de esta vida llenen {{plural_you:sus pensamientos|vuestros pensamientos}}. Si lo {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}}, aquel día llegará cuando menos lo {{plural_you:esperen|esperéis}}, \v 35 como una trampa que atrapa a un animal. Ese día les llegará a todos los que viven en la tierra.

fr.L: Mais prenez garde à vous-mêmes, de peur que vos cœurs ne soient alourdis par la débauche et l’ivresse et les soucis de la vie, et que ce jour-là ne fonde sur vous soudainement \v 35 comme un piège ; car il viendra sur tous ceux qui habitent sur la face de toute la terre.
fr.B: Soyez sur vos gardes. Ne laissez pas vos cœurs s’alourdir dans les fêtes débridées, la boisson et les soucis de la vie de tous les jours, sinon ce jour-là vous prendra au dépourvu, \v 35 comme un piège qui se referme. Car il s’abattra sur tous ceux qui habitent la terre entière.
fr.R: Faites attention ! Ne laissez pas vos pensées se remplir de fêtes, de trop d’alcool ou de soucis pour cette vie. Sinon, ce jour-là arrivera sur vous au moment où vous ne l’attendez pas, \v 35 comme un piège qui attrape un animal. Ce jour-là viendra pour tous les gens qui vivent sur la terre.

sw.L: Lakini jiangalieni wenyewe, mioyo yenu isije ikalemewa na anasa na ulevi na wasiwasi wa maisha, na siku ile ikawajia ghafla \v 35 kama mtego; kwa maana itawajia wote wanaokaa juu ya uso wa dunia yote.
sw.B: Jihadharini, mioyo yenu isije ikafanywa mizito na sherehe za anasa, ulevi na wasiwasi wa maisha ya kila siku, na siku ile ikawajia ghafla \v 35 kama mtego unaonasa. Itawajia wote wanaoishi popote duniani.
sw.R: Jihadharini! Msikubali sherehe za anasa, kunywa pombe kupita kiasi au kuhangaikia maisha haya vijaze mawazo yenu. Mkifanya hivyo, siku ile itawajia wakati msioutarajia, \v 35 kama mtego unaomnasa mnyama. Siku hiyo itawajia watu wote wanaoishi duniani.

vi.L: Nhưng hãy giữ mình, kẻo lòng các con bị nặng nề vì chè chén, say sưa và lo lắng về đời sống, và ngày ấy thình lình đến trên các con \v 35 như một cái bẫy; vì ngày ấy sẽ đến trên mọi người sống trên khắp mặt đất.
vi.B: Hãy đề phòng, đừng để lòng các con trở nên chai lì vì tiệc tùng, rượu chè và những lo toan của cuộc sống, kẻo ngày ấy đến bất ngờ trên các con \v 35 như một cái bẫy sập xuống. Vì ngày ấy sẽ đến trên tất cả mọi người sống trên khắp mặt đất.
vi.R: Hãy cẩn thận! Đừng để những bữa tiệc ồn ào, rượu chè hay những lo lắng về cuộc sống này chiếm hết tâm trí các con. Nếu không, ngày ấy sẽ đến trên các con lúc các con không ngờ, \v 35 như cái bẫy sập xuống bắt con thú. Ngày ấy sẽ đến với mọi người sống trên đất.

decisions.choice: carousing: wild drinking and its after-effects
decisions.reason: The word is used of the headache and sickness after a night of drinking, and so of drunken revelry itself.

decisions.choice: hearts weighed down: made dull and heavy, not alert to God
decisions.reason: A heavy heart here is one made sluggish by pleasure or worry, like the seed choked by worries and pleasures (8:14).

decisions.choice: that day: the day the Son of Man comes
decisions.reason: Jesus has spoken of the day of the Son of Man (17:24-30). The next verse says it will come on the whole earth.

decisions.choice: like a trap: suddenly, without warning
decisions.reason: Isaiah warns of terror, pit and snare coming on those who live on the earth (Isaiah 24:17).

decisions.choice: sitting on the face of the whole earth: living anywhere on earth
decisions.reason: To sit is a Hebrew way of saying to live in a place (Jeremiah 25:29).

decisions.choice: worries (B); worrying (R); cares (L)
decisions.reason: As in 12:22-26, Balanced and Readable use the everyday word.

decisions.choice: "Hãy giữ mình" (L); "Hãy đề phòng" (B); "Hãy cẩn thận" (R)
decisions.reason: The warning forms of Mark 13:5, with "giữ mình" at Literal for "take heed to yourselves".

source.text: ἀγρυπνεῖτε δὲ ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ δεόμενοι ἵνα κατισχύσητε ἐκφυγεῖν ταῦτα πάντα τὰ μέλλοντα γίνεσθαι, καὶ σταθῆναι ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

records.literal_gloss: Keep awake then in every time praying that you may have strength to escape these things all the things being about to take place, and to stand before the Son of the Man.

en.L: But stay awake at all times, praying that you may have strength to escape all these things that are about to take place, and to stand before the Son of Man."
en.B: Keep watch at all times, and pray for strength to come safely through all that is going to happen, and to stand before the Son of Man."
en.R: Always be ready, and keep praying. Pray that God will make you strong enough to get through all these things that are going to happen. Pray that you will be able to stand in front of the Son of Man without fear."

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:velen|velad}} en todo tiempo, orando para que {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} fuerzas para escapar de todas estas cosas que están por suceder, y para estar en pie delante del Hijo del Hombre».
es.B: {{plural_you:Estén|Estad}} alerta en todo momento, y {{plural_you:oren|orad}} pidiendo fuerzas para salir a salvo de todo lo que va a suceder, y para {{plural_you:presentarse|presentaros}} ante el Hijo del Hombre».
es.R: {{plural_you:Estén|Estad}} siempre preparados, y no {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} de orar. {{plural_you:Pidan|Pedid}} que Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} dé fuerzas para pasar por todas estas cosas que van a suceder. {{plural_you:Pidan|Pedid}} poder estar de pie delante del Hijo del Hombre sin miedo».

fr.L: Mais veillez en tout temps, priant pour que vous ayez la force d’échapper à toutes ces choses qui vont arriver, et de vous tenir debout devant le Fils de l’homme. »
fr.B: Restez vigilants en tout temps, et priez pour avoir la force de traverser sans dommage tout ce qui va arriver, et de vous tenir debout devant le Fils de l’homme. »
fr.R: Soyez toujours prêts, et continuez à prier. Priez pour que Dieu vous rende assez forts pour traverser toutes ces choses qui vont arriver. Priez pour pouvoir vous tenir devant le Fils de l’homme sans avoir peur. »

sw.L: Lakini kesheni kila wakati, mkiomba ili mpate nguvu ya kuyaepuka mambo haya yote yatakayotokea, na kusimama mbele ya Mwana wa Adamu."
sw.B: Kaeni macho nyakati zote, na ombeni mpewe nguvu ya kuvuka salama katika yote yatakayotokea, na kusimama mbele ya Mwana wa Adamu."
sw.R: Kuweni tayari sikuzote, na endeleeni kuomba. Ombeni Mungu awape nguvu ya kupita salama katika mambo haya yote yatakayotokea. Ombeni mweze kusimama mbele ya Mwana wa Adamu bila hofu."

vi.L: Nhưng hãy tỉnh thức mọi lúc, cầu nguyện để các con có đủ sức thoát khỏi mọi điều sắp xảy ra và đứng trước mặt Con Người."
vi.B: Hãy luôn luôn tỉnh thức và cầu nguyện, để các con có đủ sức vượt qua mọi điều sắp xảy ra và đứng vững trước mặt Con Người."
vi.R: Hãy luôn sẵn sàng, và cứ cầu nguyện. Hãy cầu xin Đức Chúa Trời làm cho các con đủ mạnh mẽ để vượt qua mọi điều sắp xảy ra. Hãy cầu xin để các con có thể đứng trước mặt Con Người mà không sợ hãi."

decisions.choice: you may have strength
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT reads "have strength", with Sinaiticus, Vaticanus and other early manuscripts. Alexandrinus, Bezae and most later manuscripts read "be counted worthy", the reading of the Textus Receptus, the Greek text printed in the sixteenth century. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: stay awake: be alert and watchful
decisions.reason: The verb means to keep from sleeping, and so to stay alert, like slaves waiting for their master (12:35-40).

decisions.choice: escape: come safely through
decisions.reason: Disciples will suffer (21:12-17). To escape is to come through these things without falling away.

decisions.choice: to stand before the Son of Man: to be approved by him when he comes to judge
decisions.reason: To stand in the judgment is to be accepted by the judge (Psalm 1:5; Malachi 3:2).

decisions.choice: God will make you strong; without fear
alternatives: you may have strength; to stand
decisions.reason: Readable names who gives strength and says what standing before the Son of Man means, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: the quotation closes here
alternatives: a separate quotation for each sentence
decisions.reason: The speech begun in 21:29 ends.

decisions.choice: "tỉnh thức" (L, B); "sẵn sàng" (R)
decisions.reason: Here the word is about staying alert at all times, not a night watch, so "tỉnh thức" rather than Mark's "thức canh".

source.text: Ἦν δὲ τὰς ἡμέρας ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ διδάσκων, τὰς δὲ νύκτας ἐξερχόμενος ηὐλίζετο εἰς τὸ ὄρος τὸ καλούμενον Ἐλαιῶν·

records.literal_gloss: He was now the days in the temple teaching, the and nights going out he was lodging on the mountain the [one] called of Olives;

en.L: Now during the days {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was teaching in the temple, and at night {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went out and spent the night on the mountain called [the Mount] of Olives.
en.B: By day Jesus was teaching in the temple. At night {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would go out of the city and spend the night on the hill known as the Mount of Olives.
en.R: Every day Jesus taught in the temple. Every night {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} left the city and stayed on the Mount of Olives.

es.L: Durante los días estaba enseñando en el templo, y por las noches salía y pasaba la noche en el monte llamado de los Olivos.
es.B: De día, Jesús enseñaba en el templo. De noche salía de la ciudad y la pasaba en el cerro conocido como monte de los Olivos.
es.R: Cada día Jesús enseñaba en el templo. Cada noche salía de la ciudad y se quedaba en el monte de los Olivos.

fr.L: Or, pendant les jours, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était dans le temple à enseigner, et, les nuits, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sortait et logeait sur la montagne appelée [mont] des Oliviers.
fr.B: Le jour, Jésus enseignait dans la cour du temple. La nuit, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sortait de la ville et allait passer la nuit sur la colline qu’on appelle le mont des Oliviers.
fr.R: Chaque jour, Jésus enseignait dans la cour du temple. Chaque nuit, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} quittait la ville et restait sur le mont des Oliviers.

sw.L: Basi mchana alikuwa akifundisha hekaluni, na usiku akitoka nje alikuwa akilala kwenye mlima unaoitwa [Mlima] wa Mizeituni.
sw.B: Mchana Yesu alikuwa akifundisha hekaluni. Usiku alikuwa akitoka nje ya mji na kulala kwenye kilima kiitwacho Mlima wa Mizeituni.
sw.R: Kila siku Yesu alifundisha hekaluni. Kila usiku alitoka nje ya mji, akakaa kwenye Mlima wa Mizeituni.

vi.L: Ban ngày {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dạy dỗ trong đền thờ, còn ban đêm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra ngoài và nghỉ đêm trên núi gọi là [núi] Ô-li-ve.
vi.B: Ban ngày Đức Giê-xu giảng dạy trong sân đền thờ. Ban đêm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra khỏi thành và nghỉ đêm trên ngọn đồi gọi là núi Ô-li-ve.
vi.R: Ngày nào Đức Giê-xu cũng giảng dạy trong sân đền thờ. Đêm nào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng rời khỏi thành và ở lại trên núi Ô-li-ve.

decisions.choice: lodged: spent the night, perhaps in the open
decisions.reason: The verb means to spend the night. Jesus and the disciples went to the Mount of Olives as their custom (22:39); Mark 11:11 says they went out to Bethany, on the same hill.

decisions.choice: the Mount of Olives: the hill east of Jerusalem, across the Kidron valley
decisions.reason: Jesus came down this hill when he entered the city (19:29, 37).

decisions.choice: Jesus; out of the city, left the city
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jesus and say where he went out from.

decisions.choice: le temple (L); la cour du temple (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 2:27: Jesus taught in the courts of the temple, not in the building, and Balanced and Readable say so. The imperfects ("enseignait", "sortait") say what he did day after day.

decisions.choice: "đền thờ" (L), "sân đền thờ" (B, R) (also 21:38); "núi Ô-li-ve"
decisions.reason: As in Luke 19:45 and Mark 13:3.

source.text: καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὤρθριζεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἀκούειν αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And all the people were rising early to him in the temple to hear him.

en.L: And all the people would come to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} early in the morning in the temple to hear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: At dawn all the people would come to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in the temple to listen.
en.R: All the people got up early each morning and came to the temple to listen to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y todo el pueblo venía de madrugada a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en el templo para oírlo.
es.B: Al amanecer, todo el pueblo acudía a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en el templo para escucharlo.
es.R: Toda la gente se levantaba temprano cada mañana e iba al templo a escucharlo.

fr.L: Et tout le peuple venait de grand matin vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dans le temple pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}écouter.
fr.B: Dès l’aube, tout le peuple venait {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} trouver dans la cour du temple pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}écouter.
fr.R: Tout le peuple se levait tôt chaque matin et venait dans la cour du temple pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}écouter.

sw.L: Na watu wote walikuwa wakiamka mapema kwenda {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} hekaluni ili kumsikiliza.
sw.B: Alfajiri watu wote walikuwa wakimjia hekaluni ili kumsikiliza.
sw.R: Watu wote waliamka mapema kila asubuhi na kwenda hekaluni kumsikiliza.

vi.L: Và cả dân chúng sáng sớm đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong đền thờ để nghe {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Từ sáng sớm, cả dân chúng đã đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong sân đền thờ để nghe {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dạy.
vi.R: Mỗi buổi sáng, tất cả dân chúng đều dậy sớm và đến sân đền thờ để nghe {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dạy.

decisions.choice: come early: get up at dawn to come
decisions.reason: The verb means to rise early in the morning. The people came at first light.

decisions.choice: the chapter ends here
alternatives: the story of the woman caught in adultery follows
decisions.reason: A group of later manuscripts places the story of the woman caught in adultery (John 7:53-8:11) after this verse. It is not part of Luke in the SBLGNT. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.
